ASCII0 = HEX0 + 49 + 1     # column where the text area starts
MAC = sys.platform == "darwin"
MOD = "Command" if MAC else "Control"
HEXDIGITS = "0123456789abcdef"


def hex_col(i):
    return HEX0 + i * 3 + (1 if i >= 8 else 0)


class HexEditor:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.data = bytearray()
        self.orig = b""
        self.path = None
        self.pos = 0
        self.nibble = 0          # 0 = next hex digit is the high half
        self.ascii_mode = False
        self.top = 0             # first visible row
        self.undo, self.redo = [], []
        self.found = (0, 0)      # (start, length) of last search hit
        self.last_find = None
        self.dirty = False

        fam = "Menlo" if MAC else ("Consolas" if sys.platform.startswith("win") else "Courier")
        self.font = tkfont.Font(family=fam, size=13)

        header = "Offset    " + " ".join(f"{i:02X}" for i in range(8)) + "  " + \
                 " ".join(f"{i:02X}" for i in range(8, 16)) + "  Text"
        tk.Label(root, text=header, font=self.font, anchor="w").pack(fill="x")

        frame = tk.Frame(root)
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.text = tk.Text(frame, width=ASCII0 + COLS + 1, height=ROWS, font=self.font,
                            wrap="none", cursor="xterm", state="disabled",
                            exportselection=False)
        self.scroll = tk.Scrollbar(frame, command=self.on_scrollbar)
        self.scroll.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.text.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        self.text.tag_config("cur", background="#3399ff", foreground="white")
        self.text.tag_config("curalt", background="#cce5ff")
        self.text.tag_config("mod", foreground="#d00000")
        self.text.tag_config("found", background="#ffe066")
        self.text.tag_raise("cur")

        self.status = tk.Label(root, anchor="w", font=self.font)
        self.status.pack(fill="x")

        self.build_menu()
        self.text.bind("<Button-1>", self.on_click)
        self.text.bind("<B1-Motion>", lambda e: "break")
        self.text.bind("<Key>", self.on_key)
        self.text.bind("<MouseWheel>", self.on_wheel)
        self.text.bind("<Button-4>", lambda e: self.scroll_rows(-3))
        self.text.bind("<Button-5>", lambda e: self.scroll_rows(3))
        self.text.focus_set()
        root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.quit)
        self.render()

    # ---------- menus ----------
    def build_menu(self):
        bar = tk.Menu(self.root)
        f = tk.Menu(bar, tearoff=0)
        edit = tk.Menu(bar, tearoff=0)
        items = [
            (f, "Open...", "o", self.open_dialog), (f, "Save", "s", self.save),
            (f, "Save As...", None, self.save_as), (f, "Quit", "q", self.quit),
            (edit, "Undo", "z", self.do_undo), (edit, "Redo", "y", self.do_redo),
            (edit, "Insert zero byte", "i", self.insert_byte),
            (edit, "Delete byte (Delete key)", None, self.delete_byte),
            (edit, "Go to offset...", "g", self.goto),
            (edit, "Find hex bytes...", "f", self.find_hex),
            (edit, "Find text...", "t", self.find_text),
            (edit, "Find next", "k", self.find_next),
        ]
        for menu, label, key, cmd in items:
            if key:
                menu.add_command(label=label, command=cmd,
                                 accelerator=f"{'Cmd' if MAC else 'Ctrl'}+{key.upper()}")
                self.root.bind(f"<{MOD}-{key}>", lambda e, c=cmd: (c(), "break")[1])
            else:
                menu.add_command(label=label, command=cmd)
        bar.add_cascade(label="File", menu=f)
        bar.add_cascade(label="Edit", menu=edit)
        self.root.config(menu=bar)

    # ---------- file handling ----------
    def load(self, path):
        try:
            with open(path, "rb") as fh:
                self.data = bytearray(fh.read())
        except OSError as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Cannot open", str(e))
            return
        self.orig = bytes(self.data)
        self.path, self.pos, self.nibble, self.top = path, 0, 0, 0
        self.undo, self.redo, self.found, self.dirty = [], [], (0, 0), False
        self.render()

    def confirm_discard(self):
        if not self.dirty:
            return True
        ans = messagebox.askyesnocancel("Unsaved changes", "Save your changes first?")
        if ans is None:
            return False
        return self.save() if ans else True

    def open_dialog(self):

BAUD_RATES = ["300", "1200", "2400", "4800", "9600", "19200", "38400",

LINE_ENDINGS = {"None": "", "Newline (\\n)": "\n", "Carriage return (\\r)": "\r",

class SerialMonitor(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):

        self.history = []
        self.history_pos = 0

        self._build_ui()
        self.refresh_ports()
        self.after(50, self._drain_queue)
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._on_close)

    # ---------- UI ----------
    def _build_ui(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        top.pack(fill="x")

        ttk.Label(top, text="Port:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.port_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.port_box = ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.port_var, width=30)
        self.port_box.grid(row=0, column=1, padx=4)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Refresh", command=self.refresh_ports).grid(row=0, column=2)

        ttk.Label(top, text="Baud:").grid(row=0, column=3, padx=(12, 0))
        self.baud_var = tk.StringVar(value="9600")
        ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.baud_var, values=BAUD_RATES,
                     width=9).grid(row=0, column=4, padx=4)

        self.connect_btn = ttk.Button(top, text="Connect", command=self.toggle_connection)
        self.connect_btn.grid(row=0, column=5, padx=(12, 0))

        opts = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(8, 0))
        opts.pack(fill="x")
        self.hex_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.stamp_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.scroll_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        ttk.Checkbutton(opts, text="Show as hex", variable=self.hex_var).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Checkbutton(opts, text="Timestamps", variable=self.stamp_var).pack(side="left", padx=8)
        ttk.Checkbutton(opts, text="Auto-scroll", variable=self.scroll_var).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(opts, text="Save log...", command=self.save_log).pack(side="right")
        ttk.Button(opts, text="Clear", command=self.clear).pack(side="right", padx=6)

        mid = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        mid.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.text = tk.Text(mid, wrap="word", state="disabled", font=("Menlo", 12))
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(mid, command=self.text.yview)
        self.text.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)
        scroll.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.text.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        self.text.tag_configure("rx", foreground="#0a7a2f")
        self.text.tag_configure("tx", foreground="#1c5fd4")
        self.text.tag_configure("info", foreground="#888888")
        self.text.tag_configure("err", foreground="#c0392b")

        bottom = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        bottom.pack(fill="x")
        self.send_var = tk.StringVar()
        entry = ttk.Entry(bottom, textvariable=self.send_var)
        entry.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.send())
        entry.bind("<Up>", lambda e: self._recall(-1))
        entry.bind("<Down>", lambda e: self._recall(1))
        self.ending_var = tk.StringVar(value="Newline (\\n)")
        ttk.Combobox(bottom, textvariable=self.ending_var, values=list(LINE_ENDINGS),
                     state="readonly", width=20).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.send_btn = ttk.Button(bottom, text="Send", command=self.send)
        self.send_btn.pack(side="left")

        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Not connected")
        ttk.Label(self, textvariable=self.status, relief="sunken", anchor="w",
                  padding=4).pack(fill="x", side="bottom")

    # ---------- Helpers ----------
    def log(self, msg, tag="info", newline=True):
        prefix = time.strftime("[%H:%M:%S] ") if self.stamp_var.get() else ""
        self.text.configure(state="normal")
        self.text.insert("end", prefix + msg + ("\n" if newline else ""), tag)
        self.text.configure(state="disabled")
        if self.scroll_var.get():
            self.text.see("end")

    def refresh_ports(self):
        ports = [p.device for p in list_ports.comports()]
        self.port_box["values"] = ports
        if ports and not self.port_var.get():
            self.port_var.set(ports[0])
        self.status_set(f"Found {len(ports)} port(s)" if not self.running else None)

    def status_set(self, text):
        if text:
            self.status.set(text)

    # ---------- Connection ----------
    def toggle_connection(self):
        if self.running:
            self.disconnect()
        else:
            self.connect()

    def connect(self):
        port = self.port_var.get().strip()
        if not port:
            messagebox.showwarning("No port", "Pick a port first (click Refresh if empty).")
            return
        try:
            baud = int(self.baud_var.get())
            self.ser = serial.Serial(port, baud, timeout=0.1)
        except Exception as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Could not connect", str(exc))
            return
        self.running = True
        self.reader = threading.Thread(target=self._read_loop, daemon=True)
        self.reader.start()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""LAN Port Scanner: a small desktop app (tkinter, standard library only).

Scans hosts on private/local networks for open TCP ports using connect scans.
Only scan networks you own or are authorized to test.
"""
import ipaddress
import queue
import socket
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

MAX_HOSTS = 1024
COMMON_PORTS = [
    21, 22, 23, 25, 53, 80, 110, 111, 135, 139, 143, 443, 445, 515, 548, 631,
    993, 995, 1433, 1723, 1883, 3306, 3389, 5000, 5353, 5432, 5900, 5985,
    8000, 8008, 8080, 8443, 8888, 9100, 9200, 27017, 32400, 62078,
]


def local_ip():
    """Best-effort local IPv4 address (no packets are actually sent)."""
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(("10.255.255.255", 1))
        return s.getsockname()[0]
    except OSError:
        return "127.0.0.1"
    finally:
        s.close()


def default_target():
    ip = local_ip()
    if ip.startswith("127."):
        return "127.0.0.1"
    return str(ipaddress.ip_network(f"{ip}/24", strict=False))


def parse_targets(text):
    """Accepts CIDR, single IP/hostname, a-b last-octet range, comma separated."""
    hosts = []
    for part in (p.strip() for p in text.split(",") if p.strip()):
        if "/" in part:
            net = ipaddress.ip_network(part, strict=False)
            hosts.extend(net.hosts() if net.num_addresses > 2 else net)
        elif "-" in part and part.rsplit("-", 1)[1].isdigit():
            base, end = part.rsplit("-", 1)
            prefix, start = base.rsplit(".", 1)
            for i in range(int(start), int(end) + 1):
                hosts.append(ipaddress.ip_address(f"{prefix}.{i}"))
        else:
            hosts.append(ipaddress.ip_address(socket.gethostbyname(part)))
    hosts = [h for h in dict.fromkeys(hosts)]
    for h in hosts:
        if not (h.is_private or h.is_loopback or h.is_link_local):
            raise ValueError(f"{h} is not a private/local address. "
                             "This tool only scans local networks.")
    if len(hosts) > MAX_HOSTS:
        raise ValueError(f"Too many hosts ({len(hosts)}); limit is {MAX_HOSTS}.")
    return [str(h) for h in hosts]


def parse_ports(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if text in ("", "common"):
        return COMMON_PORTS
    if text == "all":
        return list(range(1, 65536))
    ports = set()
    for part in text.split(","):
        part = part.strip()
        if "-" in part:
            a, b = (int(x) for x in part.split("-", 1))
            ports.update(range(a, b + 1))
        elif part:
            ports.add(int(part))
    if not ports or min(ports) < 1 or max(ports) > 65535:
        raise ValueError("Ports must be between 1 and 65535.")
    return sorted(ports)


def service_name(port):
    try:
        return socket.getservbyport(port, "tcp")
    except OSError:
        return ""


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("LAN Port Scanner")
        self.geometry("760x520")
        self.minsize(600, 400)
        self.q = queue.Queue()
        self.stop_event = threading.Event()
        self.scanning = False
        self.done = self.total = 0
        self._build()
        self.after(100, self._poll)

    def _build(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        self.target = tk.StringVar(value=default_target())
        self.ports = tk.StringVar(value="common")
        self.timeout = tk.StringVar(value="0.5")
        self.threads = tk.StringVar(value="200")

        for col, (label, var, width) in enumerate([
            ("Target", self.target, 22), ("Ports", self.ports, 16),
            ("Timeout (s)", self.timeout, 6), ("Threads", self.threads, 6),
        ]):
            ttk.Label(top, text=label).grid(row=0, column=col * 1, sticky="w", padx=4)
            ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=var, width=width).grid(
                row=1, column=col, sticky="we", padx=4)
        top.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.btn = ttk.Button(top, text="Scan", command=self.toggle)
        self.btn.grid(row=1, column=4, padx=(8, 4))
        ttk.Button(top, text="Export CSV", command=self.export).grid(row=1, column=5)

        ttk.Label(self, padding=(12, 0), foreground="gray", text=(
            "Target: CIDR (192.168.1.0/24), range (192.168.1.10-50), or IPs, comma separated. "
            "Ports: common, all, or e.g. 22,80,8000-8100.")).pack(anchor="w")

        frame = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        cols = ("host", "port", "service")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(frame, columns=cols, show="headings")
        for c, w in zip(cols, (200, 100, 200)):
            self.tree.heading(c, text=c.capitalize(),
                              command=lambda c=c: self._sort(c))
            self.tree.column(c, width=w, anchor="w")
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        self.tree.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y")

        bottom = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(8, 0, 8, 8))
        bottom.pack(fill="x")
        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(bottom, mode="determinate")
        self.progress.pack(fill="x")
        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Ready.")
        ttk.Label(bottom, textvariable=self.status).pack(anchor="w", pady=(4, 0))

    def _sort(self, col):
        rows = [(self.tree.set(i, col), i) for i in self.tree.get_children()]
        key = (lambda r: (ipaddress.ip_address(r[0]))) if col == "host" else (

        rows.sort(key=key)
        for idx, (_, i) in enumerate(rows):
            self.tree.move(i, "", idx)

"""Local network port scanner: a cross-platform desktop app (Tkinter, stdlib only).

Run:  python3 portscanner.py
Only scan networks you own or are authorized to test.
"""
import csv
import ipaddress
import queue
import socket
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

MAX_HOSTS = 1024
PRESETS = {
    "Common (~40 ports)": "21,22,23,25,53,80,110,111,135,139,143,443,445,465,587,993,995,"
                          "1433,1723,3000,3306,3389,5000,5432,5900,5985,8000,8080,8443,9100,"
                          "9200,27017,1883,5353,631,548,49152",
    "Well-known (1-1024)": "1-1024",
    "Top range (1-10000)": "1-10000",
    "All ports (1-65535)": "1-65535",
}


def local_network():
    """Best-guess local /24 (no packets are sent by this UDP connect)."""
    try:
        s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        s.connect(("10.255.255.255", 1))
        ip = s.getsockname()[0]
        s.close()
    except OSError:
        ip = "192.168.1.1"
    return str(ipaddress.ip_network(ip + "/24", strict=False))


def parse_ports(text):
    ports = set()
    for part in text.replace(" ", "").split(","):
        if not part:
            continue
        if "-" in part:
            a, b = part.split("-", 1)
            a, b = int(a), int(b)
            if a > b:
                a, b = b, a
            ports.update(range(a, b + 1))
        else:
            ports.add(int(part))
    if not ports or min(ports) < 1 or max(ports) > 65535:
        raise ValueError("Ports must be between 1 and 65535")
    return sorted(ports)


def parse_targets(text):
    """Accepts CIDR (192.168.1.0/24), ranges (192.168.1.10-50 or a-b full IPs), single hosts/names;
    comma-separated."""
    hosts = []
    for part in text.replace(" ", "").split(","):
        if not part:
            continue
        if "/" in part:
            net = ipaddress.ip_network(part, strict=False)
            hosts.extend(str(h) for h in (net.hosts() if net.num_addresses > 2 else net))
        elif "-" in part:
            left, right = part.split("-", 1)
            start = ipaddress.ip_address(left)
            if "." not in right:
                right = ".".join(left.split(".")[:-1] + [right])
            end = ipaddress.ip_address(right)
            if int(end) < int(start):
                raise ValueError(f"Bad range: {part}")
            if int(end) - int(start) >= MAX_HOSTS:
                raise ValueError(f"Too many hosts (max {MAX_HOSTS})")
            hosts.extend(str(ipaddress.ip_address(i)) for i in range(int(start), int(end) + 1))
        else:
            hosts.append(socket.gethostbyname(part))
        if len(hosts) > MAX_HOSTS:
            raise ValueError(f"Too many hosts (max {MAX_HOSTS})")
    if not hosts:
        raise ValueError("No targets given")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(hosts))


def service_name(port):
    try:
        return socket.getservbyport(port, "tcp")
    except OSError:
        return ""


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Local Port Scanner")
        self.geometry("760x560")
        self.minsize(620, 420)
        self.q = queue.Queue()

        ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=self.targets).grid(row=0, column=1, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", padx=4, pady=2)

        ttk.Label(f, text="Ports:").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.ports = tk.StringVar(value=PRESETS["Common (~40 ports)"])
        ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=self.ports).grid(row=1, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=4, pady=2)
        self.preset = ttk.Combobox(f, values=list(PRESETS), state="readonly", width=20)
        self.preset.set("Presets…")
        self.preset.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.ports.set(PRESETS[self.preset.get()]))
        self.preset.grid(row=1, column=2, columnspan=2, padx=4)

        ttk.Label(f, text="Timeout (s):").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w")
        o = ttk.Frame(f)
        o.grid(row=2, column=1, sticky="w", padx=4, pady=2)
        self.timeout = tk.DoubleVar(value=0.5)
        ttk.Spinbox(o, from_=0.1, to=10, increment=0.1, textvariable=self.timeout, width=5).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Label(o, text="   Threads:").pack(side="left")
        self.threads = tk.IntVar(value=200)
        ttk.Spinbox(o, from_=1, to=1000, textvariable=self.threads, width=6).pack(side="left")

        self.start_btn = ttk.Button(f, text="Start scan", command=self.start)
        self.start_btn.grid(row=2, column=2, padx=4)
        self.stop_btn = ttk.Button(f, text="Stop", command=self.stop.set, state="disabled")
        self.stop_btn.grid(row=2, column=3)

        self.bar = ttk.Progressbar(self, mode="determinate")
        self.bar.pack(fill="x", padx=8)

        cols = ("host", "port", "service")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=cols, show="headings")
        for c, w in zip(cols, (200, 100, 200)):
            self.tree.heading(c, text=c.capitalize(), command=lambda c=c: self._sort(c))
            self.tree.column(c, width=w, anchor="w")
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(self, command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y", pady=8)
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=(8, 0), pady=8)

        bottom = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(8, 0, 8, 8))
        bottom.pack(side="bottom", fill="x", before=self.tree)
        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Ready")
        ttk.Label(bottom, textvariable=self.status).pack(side="left")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local network port scanner: small, fast to start, standard library only.

Scanning runs on one background thread using non-blocking sockets and a
selector, so memory stays flat no matter how many connections are in flight.
Only private, loopback and link-local addresses can be scanned.
"""
import errno
import ipaddress
import queue
import resource
import selectors
import socket
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

DEFAULT_PORTS = "1-1024,3306,3389,5432,5900,6379,8080,8443,9000,27017"
MAX_HOSTS = 65536
IN_PROGRESS = {errno.EINPROGRESS, errno.EWOULDBLOCK, errno.EALREADY}


def local_network():
    """Best guess at the local /24 (no packets are sent)."""
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(("10.255.255.255", 1))
        ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except OSError:
        ip = "127.0.0.1"
    finally:
        s.close()
    return str(ipaddress.ip_network(ip + "/24", strict=False))


def parse_ports(text):
    ports = set()
    for part in text.replace(" ", "").split(","):
        if not part:
            continue
        lo, _, hi = part.partition("-")
        lo, hi = int(lo), int(hi or lo)
        if not (1 <= lo <= hi <= 65535):
            raise ValueError(f"bad port range: {part}")
        ports.update(range(lo, hi + 1))
    if not ports:
        raise ValueError("no ports given")
    return sorted(ports)


def parse_targets(text):
    """Accepts a CIDR, a single IP, or 'a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h'. Returns (factory, count)."""
    text = text.strip()
    if "-" in text:
        a, b = (ipaddress.IPv4Address(x.strip()) for x in text.split("-", 1))
        if b < a:
            raise ValueError("range end is before start")
        first, count = int(a), int(b) - int(a) + 1
        check = [a, b]
        make = lambda: (ipaddress.IPv4Address(first + i) for i in range(count))
    else:
        net = ipaddress.ip_network(text, strict=False)
        if net.version != 4:
            raise ValueError("IPv4 only")
        check = [net.network_address, net.broadcast_address]
        count = net.num_addresses
        make = lambda: (net.hosts() if count > 2 else iter(net))
        if count > 2:
            count -= 2
    if count > MAX_HOSTS:
        raise ValueError(f"too many hosts (max {MAX_HOSTS})")
    for ip in check:
        if not (ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local):
            raise ValueError(f"{ip} is not a private address; refusing to scan")
    return make, count


def scan(make_hosts, n_hosts, ports, timeout, conc, stop, out):
    """Port-major order spreads load across hosts instead of hammering one."""
    total = n_hosts * len(ports)
    pairs = ((h, p) for p in ports for h in make_hosts())
    sel = selectors.DefaultSelector()
    pending = {}  # socket -> (host, port, deadline); insertion order == deadline order
    done = 0
    last_report = 0.0
    exhausted = False

    def finish(sock, is_open):
        nonlocal done
        host, port, _ = pending.pop(sock)
        try:
            sel.unregister(sock)
        except (KeyError, ValueError):
            pass
        sock.close()
        done += 1
        if is_open:
            out.put(("open", str(host), port))

    while not stop.is_set() and not (exhausted and not pending):
        while not exhausted and len(pending) < conc:
            nxt = next(pairs, None)
            if nxt is None:
                exhausted = True
                break
            host, port = nxt
            try:
                s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
            except OSError:  # out of file descriptors: wait for some to finish
                conc = max(1, len(pending))
                pairs = _push_back(nxt, pairs)
                break
            s.setblocking(False)
            err = s.connect_ex((str(host), port))
            pending[s] = (host, port, time.monotonic() + timeout)
            if err == 0:
                finish(s, True)
            elif err in IN_PROGRESS:
                sel.register(s, selectors.EVENT_WRITE)
            else:
                finish(s, False)

            for key, _ in sel.select(0.05):
                s = key.fileobj
                finish(s, s.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_ERROR) == 0)
            now = time.monotonic()
            for s in list(pending):
                if pending[s][2] > now:
                    break
                finish(s, False)

        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - last_report > 0.1:
            last_report = now
            out.put(("progress", done, total))

        finish(s, False)
        done -= 1  # aborted, not completed
    sel.close()
    out.put(("progress", done, total))
    out.put(("end", stop.is_set()))

import unittest

from engine import Sheet, col_name, col_index


def make(**cells):
    sh = Sheet()
    for name, raw in cells.items():
        import re
        m = re.match(r'([A-Z]+)(\d+)$', name)
        sh.set(int(m.group(2)) - 1, col_index(m.group(1)), raw)
    return sh


class EngineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def ev(self, formula, **cells):
        sh = make(Z99=formula, **cells)
        return sh.display(98, 25)

    def test_col_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(col_name(0), 'A')
        self.assertEqual(col_name(25), 'Z')
        self.assertEqual(col_name(26), 'AA')
        self.assertEqual(col_index('AA'), 26)

    def test_arithmetic(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=1+2*3'), '7')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=(1+2)*3'), '9')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=-2^2'), '4')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=50%'), '0.5')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=1/3'), '0.3333333333')

    def test_refs_and_ranges(self):
        cells = dict(A1='1', A2='2', A3='3', B1='=SUM(A1:A3)')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=B1*2', **cells), '12')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=AVERAGE(A1:A3)', **cells), '2')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=MAX(A1:A3, 10)', **cells), '10')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=COUNT(A1:A3)', **cells), '3')

    def test_text_and_logic(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('="a"&"b"'), 'ab')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=IF(1>2,"x","y")'), 'y')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=UPPER("hi")'), 'HI')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=AND(TRUE,1<2)'), 'TRUE')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=IFERROR(1/0,"bad")'), 'bad')

    def test_errors(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=1/0'), '#DIV/0!')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=FOO(1)'), '#NAME?')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('="a"+1'), '#VALUE!')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=1+'), '#ERR!')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=SQRT(-1)'), '#NUM!')

    def test_cycle(self):
        sh = make(A1='=B1', B1='=A1')
        self.assertEqual(sh.display(0, 0), '#CYCLE!')

    def test_recalc_after_edit(self):
        sh = make(A1='1', A2='=A1+1')
        self.assertEqual(sh.display(1, 0), '2')
        sh.set(0, 0, '10')
        self.assertEqual(sh.display(1, 0), '11')

    def test_round(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=ROUND(2.5)'), '3')
        self.assertEqual(self.ev('=ROUND(-2.567,2)'), '-2.57')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CSV Viewer: open very large CSV files, then sort and filter them.

Design (why it handles big files):
  * The file is never loaded into memory. A background thread builds an index
    of byte offsets, one per record (quote-aware, so multi-line fields work).
    Rows are read from disk on demand, only the ones visible on screen.
  * The table is drawn on a canvas and scrolled by row index, so there is no
    widget-per-row and no pixel-height limit.
  * Filtering and sorting run in a background thread over the file. Matching
    row numbers are kept in a compact array; results appear live while
    filtering. Sorting reads the sort column of the matching rows only.

Standard library only (Python 3.8+ with tkinter).
"""
import csv
import io
import os
import re
import sys
import threading
import time
from array import array
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, font as tkfont, messagebox, ttk

csv.field_size_limit(2**31 - 1)

ROW_H = 22
HEADER_H = 28
MIN_COL_W = 40
OPS = ["contains", "not contains", "equals", "starts with", "ends with",
       "matches regex", ">", ">=", "<", "<=", "is empty", "not empty"]
ANY = "(any column)"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data source
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CsvSource:
    """Random-access view of a CSV file via a byte-offset index."""

    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.size = os.path.getsize(path)
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            first = f.readline(1 << 20).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        self.delimiter = max(",;\t|", key=first.count) if first else ","
        with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace") as f:
            self.header = next(csv.reader(f, delimiter=self.delimiter), [])
        self.offsets = array("Q", [0])  # start of each record; header is record 0
        self.scanned = 0
        self.done = False
        self.fh = open(path, "rb")  # main-thread handle
        threading.Thread(target=self._index, daemon=True).start()

    @property
    def nrows(self):
        return max(len(self.offsets) - 2, 0)

    def _index(self):
        offsets = self.offsets
        append = offsets.append
        pos = 0
        in_quote = False
        n = 0
        with open(self.path, "rb") as f:
            for line in f:
                pos += len(line)
                if b'"' in line and line.count(b'"') % 2:
                    in_quote = not in_quote
                if not in_quote:
                    append(pos)
                n += 1
                if n & 0xFFFF == 0:
                    self.scanned = pos
        if offsets[-1] != pos:  # file ended inside an open quote
            append(pos)
        self.scanned = pos
        self.done = True

    def fetch(self, i, fh=None):
        """Return data row i as a list of strings, or None if not indexed yet."""
        rec = i + 1
        offsets = self.offsets
        if rec + 1 >= len(offsets):
            return None
        a, b = offsets[rec], offsets[rec + 1]
        fh = fh or self.fh
        fh.seek(a)
        text = fh.read(b - a).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        return next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=self.delimiter), [])

    def close(self):
        self.fh.close()


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filters
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def make_test(op, val):
    """Return (predicate(str)->bool, negate)."""
    v = val.lower()
    neg = op in ("not contains", "not empty")
    if op in ("contains", "not contains"):
        return (lambda s: v in s.lower()), neg
    if op == "equals":
        return (lambda s: s.strip().lower() == v), False
    if op == "starts with":
        return (lambda s: s.lower().startswith(v)), False
    if op == "ends with":
        return (lambda s: s.lower().endswith(v)), False
    if op == "matches regex":
        rx = re.compile(val, re.I)
        return (lambda s: rx.search(s) is not None), False
    if op in ("is empty", "not empty"):
        return (lambda s: not s.strip()), neg
    x = float(val)  # raises ValueError for non-numeric input
    cmp = {">": lambda a: a > x, ">=": lambda a: a >= x,
           "<": lambda a: a < x, "<=": lambda a: a <= x}[op]

    def numeric(s):
        try:
            return cmp(float(s))
        except ValueError:
            return False
    return numeric, False


def compile_filter(col, op, val):
    """col is a column index or None. Returns predicate(row)->bool."""
    test, neg = make_test(op, val)
    if col is None:
        return lambda row: any(test(s) for s in row) != neg

    def pred(row):
        s = row[col] if col < len(row) else ""
        return test(s) != neg
    return pred


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Application
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("CSV Viewer")
        root.geometry("1100x700")
        self.src = None
        self.view = None        # None = all rows, else array of row numbers
        self.filters = []       # (col or None, op, value)
        self.sort = None        # (col, descending) or None
        self.token = None       # identifies the current filter/sort job
        self.job_msg = ""
        self.widths = []
        self.top = 0
        self.xoff = 0
        self.sel = None
        self.drag = None
        self.font = tkfont.nametofont("TkDefaultFont")
        self.bold = self.font.copy()
        self.bold.configure(weight="bold")
        self.charw = max(self.font.measure("0"), 1)

        self._build_menu()
        self._build_ui()
        self.root.after(150, self._tick)
        self._last_sig = None

    # ---- UI construction ----
    def _build_menu(self):
        m = tk.Me

Only the Python standard library is used (nothing to install).

import csv, io, json, os, re, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, webbrowser

csv.field_size_limit(2**31 - 1)
TMP = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="csvviewer_")

         "numeric": [], "filename": "", "db": None}
COUNT_CACHE = {}

def pick_encoding(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        head = f.read(1 << 20)
    try:
        head[:-4].decode("utf-8-sig")
        return "utf-8-sig"
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return "cp1252"


def do_import(path):
    try:
        size = max(os.path.getsize(path), 1)
        enc = pick_encoding(path)
        db_path = os.path.join(TMP, "data%d.db" % (STATE.get("n", 0) + 1))
        STATE["n"] = STATE.get("n", 0) + 1
        raw = open(path, "rb")
        text = io.TextIOWrapper(raw, encoding=enc, errors="replace", newline="")
        sample = text.read(65536)
        text.seek(0)
        try:
            dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;\t|")
        except csv.Error:
            dialect = csv.excel
        reader = csv.reader(text, dialect)
        header = next(reader, None)
        if not header:
            raise ValueError("The file looks empty.")
        n = len(header)
        header = [h.strip() or "(column %d)" % (i + 1) for i, h in enumerate(header)]
        con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        con.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=OFF")
        con.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=OFF")
        cols = ",".join("c%d TEXT" % i for i in range(n))
        con.execute("CREATE TABLE t (%s)" % cols)
        ins = "INSERT INTO t VALUES (%s)" % ",".join("?" * n)
        numeric = None
        batch, total = [], 0

        def flush():
            nonlocal batch, numeric
            if numeric is None:
                numeric = [True] * n
                seen = [False] * n
                for r in batch[:2000]:
                    for i, v in enumerate(r):
                        if v.strip():
                            seen[i] = True
                            try:
                                float(v.replace(",", ""))
                            except ValueError:
                                numeric[i] = False
                numeric = [a and b for a, b in zip(numeric, seen)]
            con.executemany(ins, batch)
            batch = []

        for row in reader:
            if len(row) < n:
                row = row + [""] * (n - len(row))
            elif len(row) > n:
                row = row[:n]

def start_import(path):
    path = os.path.expanduser(path.strip().strip("'\""))

"""Personal finance tracker. Pure standard library (tkinter + sqlite3): fast start, small footprint."""
import sqlite3

from tkinter import messagebox, ttk

import db

INCOME_COLOR = "#2e9e5b"
EXPENSE_COLOR = "#d6493f"
BAR_COLOR = "#4a78c2"


def make_tree(parent, columns, widths, height=15):
    frame = ttk.Frame(parent)
    tree = ttk.Treeview(frame, columns=[c for c, _ in columns], show="headings",
                        height=height, selectmode="browse")
    for (col, title), width in zip(columns, widths):
        tree.heading(col, text=title)
        tree.column(col, width=width, anchor="e" if title in ("Amount", "Balance", "Opening") else "w")
    bar = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=tree.yview)
    tree.configure(yscrollcommand=bar.set)
    tree.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
    bar.pack(side="right", fill="y")
    return frame, tree


class TransactionsTab(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, parent, conn):
        super().__init__(parent, padding=8)
        self.conn = conn
        self.accounts, self.categories = {}, {}
        self.selected = None

        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="Month:").pack(side="left")
        self.month = tk.StringVar()
        self.month_box = ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.month, width=10, state="readonly")
        self.month_box.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.month_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.load_rows())
        self.total = ttk.Label(top)
        self.total.pack(side="right")

        frame, self.tree = make_tree(
            self, [("date", "Date"), ("account", "Account"), ("category", "Category"),
                   ("note", "Note"), ("amount", "Amount")], [90, 120, 130, 250, 100])
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=6)
        self.tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self.on_select)

        form = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Transaction", padding=6)
        form.pack(fill="x")
        self.v_date = tk.StringVar(value=date.today().isoformat())
        self.v_account = tk.StringVar()
        self.v_kind = tk.StringVar(value="Expense")
        self.v_category = tk.StringVar()
        self.v_amount = tk.StringVar()
        self.v_note = tk.StringVar()

        def field(label, widget, col):
            ttk.Label(form, text=label).grid(row=0, column=col, sticky="w", padx=2)
            widget.grid(row=1, column=col, padx=2, sticky="we")

        field("Date", ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.v_date, width=11), 0)
        self.account_box = ttk.Combobox(form, textvariable=self.v_account, width=14, state="readonly")
        field("Account", self.account_box, 1)
        kind_box = ttk.Combobox(form, textvariable=self.v_kind, width=8, state="readonly",
                                values=["Expense", "Income"])
        kind_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.update_category_choices())
        field("Type", kind_box, 2)
        self.category_box = ttk.Combobox(form, textvariable=self.v_category, width=16, state="readonly")
        field("Category", self.category_box, 3)
        field("Amount", ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.v_amount, width=10), 4)
        form.columnconfigure(5, weight=1)
        field("Note", ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.v_note), 5)

        buttons = ttk.Frame(form)
        buttons.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=6, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
        for text, cmd in (("Add", self.add), ("Update selected", self.update),
                          ("Delete selected", self.delete), ("Clear", self.clear)):
            ttk.Button(buttons, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="left", padx=2)

    def refresh(self):
        c = self.conn
        self.accounts = {n: i for i, n in c.execute("SELECT id, name FROM accounts ORDER BY name")}
        self.categories = {n: (i, k) for i, n, k in c.execute("SELECT id, name, kind FROM categories ORDER BY name")}
        self.account_box["values"] = list(self.accounts)
        if self.v_account.get() not in self.accounts:
            self.v_account.set(next(iter(self.accounts), ""))
        self.update_category_choices()
        months = [m for (m,) in c.execute("SELECT DISTINCT substr(date, 1, 7) FROM transactions ORDER BY 1 DESC")]
        self.month_box["values"] = ["All"] + months
        if self.month.get() not in self.month_box["values"]:
            self.month.set(months[0] if months else "All")
        self.load_rows()

    def update_category_choices(self):
        kind = self.v_kind.get().lower()
        names = [n for n, (_, k) in self.categories.items() if k == kind]
        self.category_box["values"] = names
        if self.v_category.get() not in names:
            self.v_category.set(names[0] if names else "")

    def load_rows(self):

        sql = ("SELECT t.id, t.date, a.name, COALESCE(c.name, ''), t.note, t.amount "

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shop Inventory Manager: a small desktop app with barcode lookup.

Uses only the Python standard library (tkinter + sqlite3).
USB barcode scanners act as keyboards: focus the scan box, scan, and the
scanner types the code followed by Enter.
"""
import csv
import json
import sqlite3
import tkinter as tk
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

DB_PATH = Path.home() / ".shop_inventory.db"


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path=DB_PATH):
        self.db = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        self.db.execute(
            """CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                barcode TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                price REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                min_stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )"""
        )
        self.db.commit()

    def by_barcode(self, code):
        return self.db.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE barcode=?", (code,)).fetchone()

    def search(self, text=""):
        like = f"%{text}%"
        return self.db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE ? OR barcode LIKE ? ORDER BY name COLLATE NOCASE",
            (like, like),
        ).fetchall()

    def save(self, pid, barcode, name, price, qty, min_stock):
        if pid is None:
            self.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO products (barcode,name,price,quantity,min_stock) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                (barcode, name, price, qty, min_stock),
            )
        else:
            self.db.execute(
                "UPDATE products SET barcode=?,name=?,price=?,quantity=?,min_stock=? WHERE id=?",
                (barcode, name, price, qty, min_stock, pid),
            )
        self.db.commit()

    def adjust(self, pid, delta):
        self.db.execute("UPDATE products SET quantity=MAX(0,quantity+?) WHERE id=?", (delta, pid))
        self.db.commit()

    def delete(self, pid):
        self.db.execute("DELETE FROM products WHERE id=?", (pid,))
        self.db.commit()


def online_name(barcode):
    """Best-effort product name from Open Food Facts. Sends only the barcode."""
    url = f"https://world.openfoodfacts.org/api/v2/product/{barcode}.json?fields=product_name,brands"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "ShopInventoryManager/1.0"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
            data = json.load(r)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if data.get("status") != 1:
        return None
    p = data["product"]
    return " - ".join(x for x in (p.get("brands", "").split(",")[0].strip(), p.get("product_name", "")) if x) or None

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small-shop inventory manager with barcode lookup.

Stdlib only (tkinter + sqlite3) so it starts fast and stays small.
USB barcode scanners type the code and press Enter, so the scan box
at the top is kept focused and handles them directly.

Data lives in ~/.shop_inventory/inventory.db (override with INVENTORY_DB).
"""
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialog

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("INVENTORY_DB") or os.path.join(
    os.path.expanduser("~"), ".shop_inventory", "inventory.db")

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    barcode   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name      TEXT NOT NULL,
    price     REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    quantity  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    min_stock INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated   REAL NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_name ON products(name COLLATE NOCASE);
"""

COLUMNS = (("barcode", "Barcode", 140), ("name", "Name", 280),
           ("price", "Price", 80), ("quantity", "Qty", 60),
           ("min_stock", "Min", 60))

MODES = (("Lookup", 0), ("Sell (-1)", -1), ("Receive (+1)", 1))


def open_db():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DB_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    db = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    db.executescript(SCHEMA)
    return db


class ProductDialog(tk.Toplevel):
    """Add/edit form. `result` is a dict on save, otherwise None."""

    def __init__(self, parent, title, product=None, barcode=""):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title(title)
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        p = product or {"barcode": barcode, "name": "", "price": 0,
                        "quantity": 0, "min_stock": 0}
        self.vars = {}
        frm = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        frm.grid()
        for i, (key, label, _) in enumerate(COLUMNS):
            ttk.Label(frm, text=label).grid(row=i, column=0, sticky="e", pady=3)
            var = tk.StringVar(value=str(p[key]))
            self.vars[key] = var
            ttk.Entry(frm, textvariable=var, width=32).grid(
                row=i, column=1, padx=(8, 0), pady=3)
        btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
        btns.grid(row=len(COLUMNS), column=0, columnspan=2, pady=(10, 0), sticky="e")
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=self.destroy).pack(side="right")
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Save", command=self._save).pack(side="right", padx=6)
        self.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self._save())
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.destroy())
        # Focus the first empty field (name when barcode was prefilled).
        entries = [w for w in frm.winfo_children() if isinstance(w, ttk.Entry)]
        entries[1 if p["barcode"] else 0].focus_set()
        self.grab_set()
        self.wait_window()

    def _save(self):
        v = {k: var.get().strip() for k, var in self.vars.items()}
        try:
            if not v["barcode"] or not v["name"]:
                raise ValueError("Barcode and name are required.")
            data = {"barcode": v["barcode"], "name": v["name"],
                    "price": float(v["price"] or 0),
                    "quantity": int(v["quantity"] or 0),
                    "min_stock": int(v["min_stock"] or 0)}
            if data["price"] < 0 or data["quantity"] < 0 or data["min_stock"] < 0:
                raise ValueError("Price, quantity and minimum must not be negative.")
        except ValueError as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid input", str(e), parent=self)
            return
        self.result = data
        self.destroy()


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Shop Inventory")
        self.geometry("760x480")
        self.minsize(560, 320)
        self.db = open_db()
        self.mode = tk.IntVar(value=0)
        self.scan = tk.StringVar()
        self.search = tk.StringVar()
        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Ready. Scan a barcode.")
        self._build()
        self.search.trace_add("write", lambda *_: self.refresh())
        self.refresh()
        self.scan_entry.focus_set()
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._quit)

    # ---- UI ----
    def _build(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(10, 10, 10, 4))
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="Scan:").pack(side="left")
        self.scan_entry = ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.scan, width=24)
        self.scan_entry.pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.scan_entry.bind("<Return>", self._on_scan)
        for text, val in MODES:
            ttk.Radiobutton(top, text=text, value=val, variable=self.mode,
                            command=self.scan_entry.focus_set).pack(side="left", padx=4)

        bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(10, 0, 10, 4))
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(bar, text="Search:").pack(side="left")
        ttk.Entry(bar, textvariable=self.search, width=24).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        for text, cmd in (("Delete", self.delete), ("Edit", self.edit),
                          ("Add", self.add)):
            ttk.Button(bar, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="right", padx=2)
        ttk.Button(bar, text="+1", width=4,
                   command=lambda: self.adjust_selected(1)).pack(side="right", padx=(8, 2))
        ttk.Button(bar, text="-1", width=4,
                   command=lambda: self.adjust_selected(-1)).pack(side="right", padx=2)

        mid = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(10, 0))
        mid.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(mid, columns=[c[0] for c in COLUMNS],
                                 show="headings", selectmode="browse")
        for key, label, width in COLUMNS:
            self.tree.heading(key, text=label)

        panes.add(cf, weight=1)

        # editor

        for i, (key, label) in enumerate((("name", "Name"), ("email", "Email"), ("phone", "Phone"), ("org", "Organization"))):

        ttk.Label(ef, text="Notes").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="nw", pady=2)
        self.notes = tk.Text(ef, height=5, width=28, wrap="word")
        self.notes.grid(row=4, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=2)
        ttk.Label(ef, text="Groups").grid(row=5, column=0, sticky="nw", pady=2)
        self.gframe = ttk.Frame(ef)
        self.gframe.grid(row=5, column=1, sticky="nw", pady=2)
        bb = ttk.Frame(ef)
        bb.grid(row=6, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky="e", pady=8)

        ttk.Button(bb, text="Save", command=self.save_contact).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        ef.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        panes.add(ef, weight=0)

    # ---- groups
    def selected_group(self):
        sel = self.glist.curselection()
        return self.group_ids[sel[0]] if sel else None

    def refresh_groups(self, select=None):
        current = select if select is not None else self.selected_group()
        groups = self.db.list_groups()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PDF Toolkit: merge, split and reorder PDF pages.

Open one or more PDFs (their pages are appended, which merges them), drag
thumbnails to reorder, rotate/delete pages, then save everything as one PDF,
extract the selection, or split into several files.

Requires: pip install pymupdf   (tkinter ships with Python)
"""
import os
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, simpledialog, ttk

import fitz  # PyMuPDF

THUMB_W, THUMB_H = 130, 170
CELL_W, CELL_H = 160, 210
PAD = 8


class PageItem:
    def __init__(self, doc, pno, rot):
        self.doc = doc
        self.pno = pno
        self.rot = rot
        self.label = ""


class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("PDF Toolkit")
        root.geometry("1000x700")
        self.items = []
        self.selected = set()
        self.anchor = None
        self.cache = {}
        self.photos = []
        self.drag_start = None
        self.drop_index = None
        self.dragging = False
        self._build_ui()

    # ---------- UI ----------
    def _build_ui(self):
        bar = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=4)
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        buttons = [
            ("Add PDFs…", self.add_pdfs),
            ("Rotate ⟳", lambda: self.rotate(90)),
            ("Rotate ⟲", lambda: self.rotate(-90)),
            ("◀ Move", lambda: self.move_by(-1)),
            ("Move ▶", lambda: self.move_by(1)),
            ("Delete", self.delete_selected),
            ("Select all", self.select_all),
            ("Clear", self.clear_all),
        ]
        for text, cmd in buttons:
            ttk.Button(bar, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        bar2 = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=(4, 0, 4, 4))
        bar2.pack(fill="x")
        for text, cmd in [
            ("Save merged PDF…", self.save_all),
            ("Extract selected…", self.extract_selected),
            ("Split into files…", self.split),
        ]:
            ttk.Button(bar2, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="left", padx=2)

        frame = ttk.Frame(self.root)
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(frame, bg="#e8e8e8", highlightthickness=0)
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=self.canvas.yview)
        self.canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)

        self.status = ttk.Label(self.root, anchor="w", padding=4)
        self.status.pack(fill="x")

        c = self.canvas
        c.bind("<Configure>", lambda e: self.redraw())
        c.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self.on_press)
        c.bind("<B1-Motion>", self.on_motion)
        c.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self.on_release)
        c.bind("<MouseWheel>", lambda e: c.yview_scroll(-1 if e.delta > 0 else 1, "units"))
        c.bind("<Button-4>", lambda e: c.yview_scroll(-1, "units"))
        c.bind("<Button-5>", lambda e: c.yview_scroll(1, "units"))
        self.root.bind("<Delete>", lambda e: self.delete_selected())
        self.root.bind("<BackSpace>", lambda e: self.delete_selected())
        mod = "Command" if self.root.tk.call("tk", "windowingsystem") == "aqua" else "Control"
        self.root.bind(f"<{mod}-a>", lambda e: self.select_all())
        self.root.bind(f"<{mod}-o>", lambda e: self.add_pdfs())
        self.root.bind("<Left>", lambda e: self.move_by(-1))
        self.root.bind("<Right>", lambda e: self.move_by(1))
        self.update_status()

    def update_status(self):
        self.status.config(
            text=f"{len(self.items)} page(s), {len(self.selected)} selected. "
                 "Click to select (Shift/Ctrl for multiple), drag to reorder."
        )

    # ---------- layout / drawing ----------
    def cols(self):
        return max(1, self.canvas.winfo_width() // CELL_W)

    def cell_xy(self, i):
        cols = self.cols()
        return (i % cols) * CELL_W, (i // cols) * CELL_H

    def thumb(self, item):
        key = (id(item.doc), item.pno, item.rot)
        if key not in self.cache:
            page = item.doc[item.pno]
            page.set_rotation(item.rot)
            r = page.rect
            s = min(THUMB_W / r.width, THUMB_H / r.height)
            pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(s, s), alpha=False)
            self.cache[key] = tk.PhotoImage(data=pix.tobytes("png"))
        return self.cache[key]

    def redraw(self):
        c = self.canvas
        c.delete("all")
        for i, item in enumerate(self.items):
            x, y = self.cell_xy(i)
            sel = i in self.selected
            c.create_rectangle(
                x + 4, y + 4, x + CELL_W - 4, y + CELL_H - 4,
                fill="#9cc4f5" if sel else "#f6f6f6",
                outline="#2a6fd6" if sel else "#bbb", width=2 if sel else 1,
            )
            img = self.thumb(item)
            c.create_image(x + CELL_W // 2, y + 8 + THUMB_H // 2 + 6, image=img)
            c.create_text(x + CELL_W // 2, y + CELL_H - 16, text=f"{i + 1}  ·  {item.label}",
                          font=("TkDefaultFont", 9))
        rows = (len(self.items) + self.cols() - 1) // self.cols()
        c.configure(scrollregion=(0, 0, self.cols() * CELL_W, max(rows * CELL_H, 1)))
        if self.dragging and self.drop_index is not None:
            i = self.drop_index
            if i >= len(self.items) and self.items:
                x, y = self.cell_xy(len(self.items) - 1)
                x += CELL_W
            else:
                x, y = self.cell_xy(i)
            c.create_line(x, y + 4, x, y + CELL_H - 4, fill="#d62a2a", width=3)
        self.update_status()

    # ---------- selection / drag ----------
    def index_at(self, ex, ey):
        x, y = self.canvas.canvasx(ex), self.canvas.canvasy(ey)
        col, row = int(x // CELL_W), int(y // CELL_H)
        if col >= self.cols():
            return None
        i = row * self.cols() + col
        return i if 0 <= i < len(self.i

- **Search:** type a word and press Enter, or press Cmd+F to jump to the search box. Matches are highlighted on the page and listed in the **Search** tab. The ↑ ↓ buttons step through them.
- **Bookmarks:** click **🔖 Bookmark page** and give it a name. Click a bookmark in the sidebar to jump to it, or click ✕ to delete it.
- **Highlighting:** select text with the mouse, then click one of the four colour squares. All your highlights are listed in the **Highlights** tab, where you can delete them.
- **Remembering:** bookmarks, highlights and the last page you were on are saved in your browser, per PDF. When you reopen the same PDF in the same browser, they come back.

**Limitations**
- **Internet needed:** it loads the PDF-reading engine (the open-source PDF.js library) from the internet each time. If you want it to work offline, tell me and I'll bundle that library into a folder.
- **Highlights stay in the browser:** they aren't written into the PDF itself. Other PDF programs won't show them, and clearing your browser data erases them.
- **Search limits:** it only matches text within a single line of the PDF. A phrase that wraps onto the next line may be missed. Scanned PDFs that are just images can't be searched.
- **One page at a time:** it shows a single page rather than a continuous scroll.

I can fix any of these if they get in your way.

def _pypdf():
    import pypdf  # lazy: keeps startup fast

        mid = ttk.Frame(root)

        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="Add PDFs to begin.")

                    raise ValueError("file is password protected")
                n = len(reader.pages)
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Cannot open", f"{os.path.basename(path)}: {e}")
                continue
            self.pages.extend((path, i) for i in range(n))
        self.refresh()

    def move(self, d):
        sel = self.selected()

"""Data Plotter: load a table (CSV/TSV/Excel) and draw line, bar and scatter charts."""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.backends.backend_tkagg import FigureCanvasTkAgg, NavigationToolbar2Tk
from matplotlib.figure import Figure

CHART_TYPES = ("Line", "Bar", "Scatter")
MAX_BARS = 200


def load_table(path):
    lower = path.lower()
    if lower.endswith((".xlsx", ".xls")):
        return pd.read_excel(path)
    if lower.endswith((".tsv", ".tab")):
        return pd.read_csv(path, sep="\t")
    # sep=None lets pandas sniff comma, semicolon, tab, etc.
    return pd.read_csv(path, sep=None, engine="python")


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Data Plotter")
        self.geometry("1100x700")
        self.df = None

        self._build_controls()
        self._build_plot()

    def _build_controls(self):
        side = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        side.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.Y)

        ttk.Button(side, text="Open file…", command=self.open_file).pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.file_label = ttk.Label(side, text="No file loaded", wraplength=200)
        self.file_label.pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(4, 10))

        ttk.Label(side, text="Chart type").pack(anchor=tk.W)
        self.chart_type = tk.StringVar(value=CHART_TYPES[0])
        for t in CHART_TYPES:
            ttk.Radiobutton(side, text=t, value=t, variable=self.chart_type,
                            command=self.plot).pack(anchor=tk.W)

        ttk.Label(side, text="X column").pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(10, 0))
        self.x_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.x_box = ttk.Combobox(side, textvariable=self.x_var, state="readonly")
        self.x_box.pack(fill=tk.X)
        self.x_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.plot())

        ttk.Label(side, text="Y columns (multi-select)").pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(10, 0))
        frame = ttk.Frame(side)
        frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.y_list = tk.Listbox(frame, selectmode=tk.EXTENDED, exportselection=False,
                                 height=10)
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, command=self.y_list.yview)
        self.y_list.config(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)
        self.y_list.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        scroll.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.y_list.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", lambda e: self.plot())

        self.grid_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)

                        command=self.plot).pack(anchor=tk.W, pady=(10, 0))

        ttk.Button(side, text="Save image…", command=self.save_image).pack(
            fill=tk.X, pady=(10, 0))

    def _build_plot(self):
        right = ttk.Frame(self)
        right.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.fig = Figure(figsize=(6, 4), dpi=100)
        self.ax = self.fig.add_subplot(111)
        self.canvas = FigureCanvasTkAgg(self.fig, master=right)
        NavigationToolbar2Tk(self.canvas, right).update()
        self.canvas.get_tk_widget().pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

    def open_file(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Open table",
            filetypes=[("Tables", "*.csv *.tsv *.tab *.txt *.xlsx *.xls"),
                       ("All files", "*.*")])
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            df = load_table(path)
        except Exception as exc:
            messagebox.showerror("Could not load file", str(exc))
            return
        if df.empty or df.shape[1] == 0:
            messagebox.showerror("Could not load file", "The table is empty.")
            return

        self.df = df
        self.file_label.config(text=f"{path.split('/')[-1].split(chr(92))[-1]}\n"
                                    f"{len(df)} rows × {df.shape[1]} columns")
        cols = [str(c) for c in df.columns]
        df.columns = cols
        self.x_box["values"] = ["(row index)"] + cols
        self.x_var.set(cols[0])
        self.y_list.delete(0, tk.END)
        numeric = [c for c in cols if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])]
        for c in cols:
            self.y_list.insert(tk.END, c)
        # Preselect the first numeric column that isn't the X column.
        for i, c in enumerate(cols):
            if c in numeric and c != cols[0]:
                self.y_list.selection_set(i)
                break
        self.plot()

    def plot(self):
        self.ax.clear()
        if self.df is None:
            self.canvas.draw_idle()
            return
        ycols = [self.y_list.get(i) for i in self.y_list.curselection()]
        if not ycols:
            self.ax.set_title("Select at least one Y column")
            self.canvas.draw_idle()
            return

        df = self.df
        xname = self.x_var.get()
        use_index = xname == "(row index)"
        x = df.index if use_index else df[xname]
        kind = self.chart_type.get()

        try:
            ys = {c: pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce") for c in ycols}
            if all(v.isna().all() for v in ys.values()):
                raise ValueError("Selected Y columns contain no numeric data.")

            if kind == "Bar":
                self._draw_bars(x, ys)
            else:
                # Treat non-numeric X as categories; try parsing as dates/numbers first.
                xv = self._coerce_x(x)
                for c, y in ys.items():
                    if kind == "Line":
                        self.ax.plot(xv, y, label=c)
                    else:
                        self.ax.scatter(xv, y, label=c, s=18)
                if xv.dtype == object:
                    self.ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.ax.set_title(f"Cannot plot: {exc}")
            self.canvas.draw_idle()
            return

        self.ax.set_xlabel("row index" if use_index else xname)
        self.ax.set_ylabel

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter  # noqa: E402


def open_pdf(path):
    reader = PdfReader(path)
    if reader.is_encrypted and not reader.decrypt(""):
        raise ValueError(f"{os.path.basename(path)} is password-protected.")

def parse_pages(text, total):
    """Turn '1-3, 7, 10-' into a list of 0-based page indexes.

    Blank or 'all' means every page. Order is kept, so '5,1-3' puts page 5
    first. A backwards range such as '5-2' reverses those pages.
    """
    text = text.strip().lower()
    if text in ("", "all"):
        return list(range(total))
    pages = []
    for part in text.replace(" ", "").split(","):
        if not part:
            continue
        if "-" in part:
            a, _, b = part.partition("-")
            start = int(a) if a else 1
            end = int(b) if b else total
        else:
            start = end = int(part)
        if not (1 <= start <= total and 1 <= end <= total):
            raise ValueError(f"'{part}' is outside 1-{total}.")
        step = 1 if start <= end else -1
        pages.extend(range(start - 1, end - 1 + step, step))
    if not pages:
        raise ValueError("No pages selected.")
    return pages

"""Data Plotter: load a CSV/TSV table and draw line, bar and scatter charts.

Pure standard library (tkinter), no installs needed. Run: python3 plotter.py [file.csv]
"""
import csv
import math
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

COLORS = ["#4e79a7", "#f28e2b", "#e15759", "#76b7b2", "#59a14f",
          "#edc948", "#b07aa1", "#ff9da7", "#9c755f", "#bab0ac"]
MARGIN = dict(left=70, right=20, top=40, bottom=60)


def to_float(s):
    try:
        return float(str(s).strip().replace(",", ""))
    except ValueError:
        return None


def nice_ticks(lo, hi, n=6):
    if lo == hi:
        lo, hi = lo - 1, hi + 1
    raw = (hi - lo) / max(n, 1)
    mag = 10 ** math.floor(math.log10(raw))
    step = next(m * mag for m in (1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10) if m * mag >= raw)
    start = math.floor(lo / step) * step
    ticks, v = [], start
    while v <= hi + step * 1e-9:
        ticks.append(round(v, 12))
        v += step
    return ticks


def fmt(v):
    if v == 0:
        return "0"
    if abs(v) >= 1e6 or abs(v) < 1e-3:
        return f"{v:.2e}"
    return f"{v:.6g}"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small, fast data plotter: load a CSV/TSV table, draw line, bar or scatter charts.

Standard library only (tkinter), so there is nothing to install and startup is
near-instant. Numeric columns are stored as compact array('d'); large series
are decimated to the pixel width before drawing to keep the canvas light.

Usage: python3 plotter.py [file.csv]
"""
import csv
import math
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from array import array
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

NAN = float("nan")
COLORS = ["#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd",
          "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf"]
ML, MR, MT, MB = 64, 20, 20, 44   # plot margins
MAX_SCATTER = 20000
MAX_BARS = 200
ROW_INDEX = "(row index)"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- data ----

def load_table(path):
    """Return (names, columns). A column is array('d') if numeric, else list[str]."""
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig", errors="replace") as f:
        sample = f.read(8192)
        f.seek(0)
        try:
            dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;\t|")
        except csv.Error:
            dialect = csv.excel
        reader = csv.reader(f, dialect)
        header = next(reader, None)
        if not header:
            raise ValueError("file is empty")
        names = [h.strip() or f"col{i + 1}" for i, h in enumerate(header)]
        raw = [[] for _ in names]
        for row in reader:
            if not row:
                continue
            for i in range(len(names)):
                raw[i].append(row[i].strip() if i < len(row) else "")
    cols = []
    for vals in raw:
        nums = array("d")
        ok = 0
        for v in vals:
            try:
                nums.append(float(v))
                ok += 1
            except ValueError:
                nums.append(NAN)
        nonempty = sum(1 for v in vals if v)
        cols.append(nums if nonempty and ok >= 0.9 * nonempty else vals)
    return names, cols


def nice_ticks(lo, hi, target=6):
    if hi <= lo:
        hi = lo + 1
    raw = (hi - lo) / target
    mag = 10 ** math.floor(math.log10(raw))
    step = next(m * mag for m in (1, 2, 5, 10) if m * mag >= raw)
    t = math.ceil(lo / step) * step
    out = []
    while t <= hi + step * 1e-9:
        out.append(round(t, 12))
        t += step
    return out


def fmt(v):
    if v != 0 and (abs(v) >= 1e6 or abs(v) < 1e-3):
        return f"{v:.3g}"
    return f"{v:.6g}"


def finite_range(seq):
    lo, hi = math.inf, -math.inf
    for v in seq:
        if v == v and -math.inf < v < math.inf:
            if v < lo:
                lo = v
            if v > hi:
                hi = v
    return lo, hi


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- app ----

class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("Plotter")
        root.geometry("1000x640")
        self.names, self.cols = [], []
        self._redraw_job = None

        bar = ttk.Frame(root, padding=6)
        bar.pack(side="top", fill="x")
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Open…", command=self.open_dialog).pack(side="left")
        self.kind = tk.StringVar(value="line")
        for k in ("line", "bar", "scatter"):
            ttk.Radiobutton(bar, text=k.capitalize(), value=k, variable=self.kind,
                            command=self.schedule).pack(side="left", padx=(10, 0))
        ttk.Label(bar, text="X:").pack(side="left", padx=(16, 2))
        self.xvar = tk.StringVar()
        self.xbox = ttk.Combobox(bar, textvariable=self.xvar, state="readonly", width=20)
        self.xbox.pack(side="left")
        self.xbox.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.schedule())
        self.status = ttk.Label(bar, text="Open a CSV/TSV file")
        self.status.pack(side="right")

        body = ttk.Frame(root)
        body.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        side = ttk.Frame(body, padding=(6, 0))
        side.pack(side="left", fill="y")
        ttk.Label(side, text="Y series (multi-select)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.ylist = tk.Listbox(side, selectmode="extended", exportselection=False, width=24)
        self.ylist.pack(fill="y", expand=True)
        self.ylist.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", lambda e: self.schedule())

        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(body, bg="white", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", lambda e: self.schedule())
        root.bind("<Control-o>", lambda e: self.open_dialog())
        root.bind("<Command-o>", lambda e: self.open_dialog())

    # -- loading
    def open_dialog(self):
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            filetypes=[("Tables", "*.csv *.tsv *.txt"), ("All files", "*.*")])
        if path:
            self.load(path)

    def load(self, path):
        try:
            names, cols = load_table(path)
        except Exception as e:  # report any parse/IO failure to the user
            messagebox.showerror("Could not load file", str(e))
            return
        self.names, self.cols = names, cols
        numeric = [i for i, c in enumerate(cols) if isinstance(c, array)]
        self.xbox["values"] = [ROW_INDEX] + names
        self.xvar.set(names[0] if len(names) > 1 else ROW_INDEX)
        self.ylist.delete(0, "end")
        for i in numeric:
            self.ylist.insert("end", names[i])
        self.ynames = [names[i] for i in numeric]
        # preselect the first numeric column that isn't X
        for j, n in enumerate(self.ynames):
            if n != self.xvar.get():
                self.ylist.selection_set(j)
                break
        self.status.config(text=f"{path.split('/')[-1]}: {len(cols[0])} rows × {len(names)} cols")
        self.schedule()

    # -- drawing
    def schedule(self):
        if self._redraw_job:
            self.root.after_cancel(self._redraw_job)
        self._redraw_job = self.root.after(30, self.draw)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""LAN Chat: serverless chat for a local network.

Peers find each other and exchange messages over UDP (broadcast for presence
and public chat, unicast for private messages). No server, no dependencies
beyond the Python standard library (tkinter).

Run on each machine:  python3 lanchat.py [nickname]
"""
import json
import queue
import socket
import sys
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
import uuid
from tkinter import messagebox, simpledialog

PORT = 50505
HEARTBEAT = 3.0
PEER_TIMEOUT = 10.0
MAX_TEXT = 2000
EVERYONE = "Everyone"


class Network:
    def __init__(self, name, inbox):
        self.name = name
        self.inbox = inbox
        self.uid = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.running = True
        self.sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
        self.sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        if hasattr(socket, "SO_REUSEPORT"):
            try:
                self.sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEPORT, 1)
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_BROADCAST, 1)
        self.sock.bind(("", PORT))
        self.sock.settimeout(0.5)
        threading.Thread(target=self._recv_loop, daemon=True).start()
        threading.Thread(target=self._beat_loop, daemon=True).start()

    def _packet(self, kind, text=""):
        return json.dumps(
            {"t": kind, "id": self.uid, "name": self.name, "text": text}
        ).encode()

    def _broadcast(self, data):
        for dest in ("255.255.255.255", "<broadcast>"):
            try:
                self.sock.sendto(data, (dest, PORT))
                return
            except OSError:
                continue

    def send_public(self, text):
        self._broadcast(self._packet("msg", text))

    def send_private(self, ip, text):
        self.sock.sendto(self._packet("pm", text), (ip, PORT))

    def _beat_loop(self):
        while self.running:
            try:
                self._broadcast(self._packet("hello"))
            except OSError:
                pass
            time.sleep(HEARTBEAT)

    def _recv_loop(self):
        while self.running:
            try:
                data, addr = self.sock.recvfrom(65535)
                m = json.loads(data.decode())
                if m.get("id") == self.uid or m.get("t") not in ("hello", "msg", "pm", "bye"):
                    continue
                self.inbox.put((m, addr[0]))
            except (socket.timeout, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                continue
            except OSError:
                if not self.running:
                    return

    def close(self):
        self.running = False
        try:
            self._broadcast(self._packet("bye"))
        except OSError:
            pass
        self.sock.close()


class App:
    def __init__(self, root, name):
        self.root = root
        self.inbox = queue.Queue()
        self.peers = {}  # id -> {"name", "ip", "seen"}
        self.listed = [EVERYONE]  # parallel to listbox rows (peer ids)
        try:
            self.net = Network(name, self.inbox)
        except OSError as e:
            messagebox.showerror("LAN Chat", f"Cannot open network port {PORT}:\n{e}")
            root.destroy()
            sys.exit(1)

        root.title(f"LAN Chat - {name}")
        root.geometry("720x480")
        root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.quit)

        side = tk.Frame(root)
        side.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y, padx=6, pady=6)
        tk.Label(side, text="Send to").pack(anchor="w")
        self.plist = tk.Listbox(side, width=22, exportselection=False)
        self.plist.pack(fill=tk.Y, expand=True)
        self.plist.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", lambda e: None)

        main = tk.Frame(root)
        main.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=6, pady=6)
        self.log = tk.Text(main, state=tk.DISABLED, wrap=tk.WORD)
        self.log.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.log.tag_configure("me", foreground="#1a5fb4")
        self.log.tag_configure("pm", foreground="#a51d2d")
        self.log.tag_configure("sys", foreground="#777777")

        row = tk.Frame(main)
        row.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(6, 0))
        self.entry = tk.Entry(row)
        self.entry.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.X, expand=True)
        self.entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.send())
        tk.Button(row, text="Send", command=self.send).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(6, 0))
        self.entry.focus_set()

        self.refresh_peers()
        self.add(f"You are '{name}'. Looking for peers on the local network...", "sys")
        self.poll()

    def add(self, text, tag=None):
        self.log.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        stamp = time.strftime("%H:%M")
        self.log.insert(tk.END, f"[{stamp}] {text}\n", tag)
        self.log.config(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log.see(tk.END)

    def refresh_peers(self):
        sel = self.listed[self.plist.curselection()[0]] if self.plist.curselection() else EVERYONE
        self.listed = [EVERYONE] + sorted(self.peers, key=lambda i: self.peers[i]["name"].lower())
        self.plist.delete(0, tk.END)
        for pid in self.listed:
            self.plist.insert(tk.END, EVERYONE if pid == EVERYONE else self.peers[pid]["name"])
        self.plist.selection_set(self.listed.index(sel) if sel in self.listed else 0)

    def send(self):
        text = self.entry.get().strip()[:MAX_TEXT]
        if not text:
            return
        sel = self.plist.curselection()
        target = self.listed[sel[0]] if sel else EVERYONE
        try:
            if target == EVERYONE:
                self.net.send_public(text)
                self.add(f"me: {text}", "me")
            else:
                self.net.send_private(self.peers[target]["ip"], text)
                self.add(f"me -> {self.peers[target]['name']} (private): {text}", "pm")
        except OSError as e:
            self.add(f"Send failed: {e}", "sys")
            ret
