"""Recipe Manager: recipes, ingredient scaling and a shopping list.

Pure standard library (Python 3.8+ with Tkinter), so it runs unchanged on
Windows, macOS and Linux.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import uuid
import tkinter as tk
from fractions import Fraction
from tkinter import messagebox, ttk

APP_NAME = "RecipeManager"


# ---------- storage ----------

def data_path():
    if sys.platform.startswith("win"):
        base = os.environ.get("APPDATA") or os.path.expanduser("~")
    elif sys.platform == "darwin":
        base = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support")
    else:
        base = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME") or os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share")
    folder = os.path.join(base, APP_NAME)
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    return os.path.join(folder, "data.json")


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.recipes = []
        self.shopping = []
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        try:
            with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
            self.recipes = data.get("recipes", [])
            self.shopping = data.get("shopping", [])
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        except (ValueError, OSError):
            # Keep the unreadable file around instead of overwriting it.
            try:
                os.replace(self.path, self.path + ".corrupt")
            except OSError:
                pass

    def save(self):
        data = {"recipes": self.recipes, "shopping": self.shopping}
        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(self.path), suffix=".tmp")
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        os.replace(tmp, self.path)


# ---------- quantities ----------

def parse_qty(text):
    """'1 1/2' -> 1.5, '0.25' -> 0.25, '' -> None. Raises ValueError if invalid."""
    text = text.strip().replace(",", ".")
    if not text:
        return None
    total = 0.0
    for part in text.split():
        if "/" in part:
            num, den = part.split("/", 1)
            total += float(num) / float(den)
        else:
            total += float(part)
    if total < 0:
        raise ValueError("negative")
    return total


def format_qty(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    frac = Fraction(value).limit_denominator(8)
    if abs(float(frac) - value) < 0.02:
        whole, rem = divmod(frac.numerator, frac.denominator)
        if rem == 0:
            return str(whole)
        part = f"{rem}/{frac.denominator}"
        return f"{whole} {part}" if whole else part
    return f"{value:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


def fmt_line(qty, unit, name):
    return " ".join(p for p in (format_qty(qty), unit, name) if p)


# ---------- ingredient entry row (shared) ----------

class IngredientRow(ttk.Frame):
    """qty / unit / name entries plus an action button."""

    def __init__(self, master, button_text, command):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.qty, self.unit, self.name = tk.StringVar(), tk.StringVar(), tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.qty, width=7).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.unit, width=9).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        e = ttk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.name)
        e.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        e.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: command())
        ttk.Button(self, text=button_text, command=command).pack(side="left", padx=(4, 0))

    def get(self):
        """Returns (qty, unit, name) or None after showing an error."""
        name = self.name.get().strip()
        if not name:
            messagebox.showwarning("Ingredient", "Please enter an ingredient name.")
            return None
        try:
            qty = parse_qty(self.qty.get())
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showwarning("Ingredient", "Quantity must be a number such as 2, 0.5 or 1 1/2.")
            return None
        return qty, self.unit.get().strip(), name

    def set(self, qty, unit, name):
        self.qty.set(format_qty(qty))
        self.unit.set(unit)
        self.name.set(name)

    def clear(self):
        self.set(None, "", "")


# ---------- recipe editor ----------

class RecipeEditor(tk.Toplevel):
    def __init__(self, master, recipe, on_save):
        super().__init__(master)
        self.title("Edit recipe" if recipe else "New recipe")
        self.on_save = on_save
        self.recipe = recipe
        self.ingredients = [dict(i) for i in recipe["ingredients"]] if recipe else []
        self.geometry("560x640")
        self.transient(master)

        body = ttk.Frame(self, padding=10)
        body.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        top = ttk.Frame(body)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="Name").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.name = tk.StringVar(value=recipe["name"] if recipe else "")
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.name).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=6)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Servings").grid(row=0, column=2)
        self.servings = tk.StringVar(value=str(recipe["servings"]) if recipe else "4")
        ttk.Spinbox(top, from_=1, to=999, width=5, textvariable=self.servings).grid(row=0, column=3, padx=6)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(body, text="Ingredients  (quantity / unit / name)").pack(anchor="w", pady=(10, 2))
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(body, columns=("i",), show="tree", height=8, selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.tree.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", self.on_select)

        self.row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        btns = ttk.Frame(body)
        btns.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Update selected", command=self.update_sel).pack(side="left")

"""LAN Chat: serverless chat GUI (tkinter). Run: python app.py [name]"""
import getpass
import queue
import sys
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import simpledialog

from node import EVERYONE, Node


class App:
    def __init__(self, root, name):
        self.root = root
        self.events = queue.Queue()
        self.history = {EVERYONE: []}   # conversation key -> [(label, text, ts, mine)]
        self.unread = set()
        self.current = EVERYONE
        self.names = {}                 # id -> name (remembered even if peer leaves)
        self.ids = [EVERYONE]           # listbox index -> conversation key

        root.title("LAN Chat")
        root.geometry("720x480")
        root.minsize(480, 300)

        left = tk.Frame(root)
        left.pack(side="left", fill="y", padx=6, pady=6)
        tk.Label(left, text="People on this network").pack(anchor="w")
        self.listbox = tk.Listbox(left, width=24, exportselection=False)
        self.listbox.pack(fill="y", expand=True)
        self.listbox.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_select)
        tk.Button(left, text="Change my name", command=self.rename).pack(fill="x", pady=(6, 0))

        right = tk.Frame(root)
        right.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(0, 6), pady=6)
        self.title = tk.Label(right, anchor="w", font=("TkDefaultFont", 11, "bold"))
        self.title.pack(fill="x")
        box = tk.Frame(right)
        box.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        sb = tk.Scrollbar(box)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.text = tk.Text(box, state="disabled", wrap="word", yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        self.text.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        sb.config(command=self.text.yview)
        self.text.tag_config("me", foreground="#1a5fb4")
        self.text.tag_config("them", foreground="#26a269")
        self.text.tag_config("sys", foreground="#888888")
        bottom = tk.Frame(right)
        bottom.pack(fill="x", pady=(6, 0))
        self.entry = tk.Entry(bottom)
        self.entry.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        self.entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.send())
        tk.Button(bottom, text="Send", command=self.send).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 0))
        self.entry.focus_set()

        self.node = Node(name, self.on_message, lambda: self.events.put(("peers",)))
        self.node.start()
        self.refresh_peers()
        self.render()
        root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.close)
        root.after(100, self.pump)

    # network threads only enqueue; the Tk thread does all UI work
    def on_message(self, name, sender, target, text, ts):
        self.events.put(("msg", name, sender, target, text, ts))

    def pump(self):
        try:
            while True:
                ev = self.events.get_nowait()
                if ev[0] == "peers":
                    self.refresh_peers()
                else:
                    _, name, sender, target, text, ts = ev
                    self.names[sender] = name
                    key = EVERYONE if target == EVERYONE else sender
                    self.add(key, name, text, ts, False)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.root.after(100, self.pump)

    def refresh_peers(self):
        peers = self.node.peer_list()
        for i, n in peers:
            self.names[i] = n
        online = {i for i, _ in peers}
        keys = [EVERYONE] + [i for i, _ in peers]
        keys += [k for k in self.history if k != EVERYONE and k not in online]  # offline w/ history
        self.ids = keys
        self.listbox.delete(0, "end")
        for k in keys:
            label = "Everyone" if k == EVERYONE else self.names.get(k, "?")
            if k != EVERYONE and k not in online:
                label += " (offline)"
            if k in self.unread:
                label = "● " + label
            self.listbox.insert("end", label)
        if self.current in keys:
            self.listbox.selection_set(keys.index(self.current))

    def on_select(self, _):
        sel = self.listbox.curselection()
        if sel:
            self.current = self.ids[sel[0]]
            self.unread.discard(self.current)
            self.refresh_peers()
            self.render()

    def add(self, key, who, text, ts, mine):
        self.history.setdefault(key, []).append((who, text, ts, mine))
        if key == self.current:
            self.render()
        else:
            self.unread.add(key)
            self.refresh_peers()

    def render(self):
        k = self.current
        self.title.config(text="Everyone (broadcast to all peers)" if k == EVERYONE
                          else f"Private chat with {self.names.get(k, '?')}")
        self.text.config(state="normal")
        self.text.delete("1.0", "end")
        for who, text, ts, mine in self.history.get(k, []):
            stamp = time.strftime("%H:%M", time.localtime(ts))
            tag = "sys" if who is None else ("me" if mine else "them")
            if who is None:
                self.text.insert("end", f"{text}\n", tag)
            else:
                self.text.insert("end", f"[{stamp}] {who}: ", tag)
                self.text.insert("end", f"{text}\n")
        self.text.config(state="disabled")
        self.text.see("end")

    def send(self):
        text = self.entry.get().strip()
        if not text:
            return
        self.entry.delete(0, "end")
        key = self.current
        self.add(key, "Me", text, time.time(), True)
        # network I/O off the UI thread
        import threading

        def work():
            failed = self.node.send(key, text)
            if failed:
                self.events.put(("msg", "", key, key, "", 0))  # no-op wake
                self.root.after(0, lambda: self.add(key, None, "⚠ not delivered to: " + ", ".join(failed),
                                                    time.time(), False))
        threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True).start()

I'll build this as a single Python file that uses only what macOS already has, so there's nothing to install. It runs a small private web page on your computer.
I've written the RSS reader, but I haven't run it, so it's untested.

**To start it**
1. Open the **Terminal** app.
2. Type `python3 ` (with a space after it) and drag the file `rss_reader.py` from Finder into the Terminal window. The file is in `/private/tmp/fwd-uwy3yt3l`.
3. Press Enter. Your browser opens the reader at `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
4. To quit, go back to Terminal and press `Ctrl+C`.

If your Mac asks to install "developer tools" the first time, accept. That installs Python.

**What you can do**
- **Add a feed:** click **+ Feed** and paste the feed's web address. If a folder is selected, the feed goes into that folder.
- **Folders:** click **+ Folder** to make one. Select a feed to move it to a folder from a dropdown. Deleting a folder keeps its feeds.
- **Unread counters:** a blue number shows next to each feed and folder, and **All items** shows the total.
- **Reading:** click a headline to see a text preview, which also marks it read. From there you can open the original article or mark it unread again.
- **Mark all read:** this applies to whatever feed, folder or view you're looking at.
- **Unread only:** a checkbox filters the list.
- **Refresh:** the **Refresh** button fetches new articles. The reader also refreshes by itself every 30 minutes while it's running.
- **Broken feeds:** a feed that can't be read gets a ⚠ in the list. Select it to see the problem.

**Good to know**
- Your feeds and read/unread state are saved in `rss_reader.db`, next to the script. Keep the two files together.
- The reader only accepts connections from your own computer, so nobody else on your network can see it.
- Previews show plain text only, with no images or formatting. Use "Open original" for the full article.
- It doesn't import OPML files, which are the export files from other readers. I can add that if you're moving from another app.

If something fails when you run it, paste the Terminal message here and I'll fix it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Download manager with pause, resume and a global speed limit.

Standard library only (tkinter + urllib). Run: python3 downloader.py
"""
import os
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

CHUNK = 16 * 1024
TIMEOUT = 20


class RateLimiter:
    """Global limiter shared by all downloads. rate is in bytes/s, 0 = unlimited."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.rate = 0
        self.next_free = 0.0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def set_rate(self, rate):
        with self.lock:
            self.rate = max(0, int(rate))
            self.next_free = time.monotonic()

    def acquire(self, n, stop):
        """Block until n bytes may be consumed. Returns early if stop is set."""
        with self.lock:
            if not self.rate:
                return
            now = time.monotonic()
            start = max(now, self.next_free)
            self.next_free = start + n / self.rate
            delay = start - now
        if delay > 0:
            stop.wait(delay)


class Download:
    def __init__(self, url, folder):
        self.url = url
        self.folder = folder
        self.name = self._pick_name()
        self.path = os.path.join(folder, self.name)
        self.part = self.path + ".part"
        self.state = "Queued"  # Queued, Downloading, Paused, Done, Error, Cancelled
        self.error = ""
        self.downloaded = os.path.getsize(self.part) if os.path.exists(self.part) else 0
        self.total = 0
        self.speed = 0.0
        self.stop = threading.Event()
        self.cancel = False
        self.thread = None
        self._samples = []

    def _pick_name(self):
        base = os.path.basename(urllib.parse.unquote(urllib.parse.urlparse(self.url).path))
        base = base or "download"
        name, ext = os.path.splitext(base)
        candidate, i = base, 1
        while os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.folder, candidate)):
            candidate = f"{name} ({i}){ext}"
            i += 1
        return candidate

    @property
    def active(self):
        return self.thread is not None and self.thread.is_alive()

    def start(self, limiter):
        if self.active or self.state in ("Done", "Cancelled"):
            return
        self.stop = threading.Event()
        self.state = "Downloading"
        self.error = ""
        self._samples = []
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, args=(limiter,), daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def pause(self):
        if self.active:
            self.stop.set()

    def abort(self):
        self.cancel = True
        self.stop.set()
        if not self.active:
            self._finish_cancel()

    def _finish_cancel(self):
        self.state = "Cancelled"
        self.speed = 0
        try:
            os.remove(self.part)
        except OSError:
            pass

    def _record(self):
        now = time.monotonic()
        self._samples.append((now, self.downloaded))
        self._samples = [s for s in self._samples if now - s[0] <= 3]
        t0, b0 = self._samples[0]
        self.speed = (self.downloaded - b0) / (now - t0) if now > t0 else 0

    def _run(self, limiter):
        try:
            self._transfer(limiter)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code == 416 and self.downloaded > 0:  # already have everything
                self._complete()
            else:
                self.state, self.error = "Error", f"HTTP {e.code}"
        except Exception as e:  # network errors etc.; .part is kept so Resume works
            self.state, self.error = "Error", str(e) or type(e).__name__
        if self.cancel:
            self._finish_cancel()
        elif self.state == "Downloading":  # stopped by pause
            self.state = "Paused"
        self.speed = 0

    def _complete(self):
        os.replace(self.part, self.path)
        self.state = "Done"
        self.total = self.downloaded

    def _transfer(self, limiter):
        headers = {"User-Agent": "PyDownloadManager/1.0"}
        if self.downloaded:
            headers["Range"] = f"bytes={self.downloaded}-"
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.url, headers=headers)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT) as resp:
            mode = "ab"
            if resp.status == 206:
                cr = resp.headers.get("Content-Range", "")  # bytes a-b/total
                tail = cr.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
                self.total = int(tail) if tail.isdigit() else 0
            else:
                # Server ignored Range (or fresh start): write from the beginning.
                mode = "wb"
                self.downloaded = 0
                length = resp.headers.get("Content-Length")
                self.total = int(length) if length and length.isdigit() else 0
            with open(self.part, mode) as f:
                while not self.stop.is_set():
                    rate = limiter.rate
                    size = min(CHUNK, rate) if rate else CHUNK
                    data = resp.read(max(size, 1))
                    if not data:
                        if self.total and self.downloaded < self.total:
                            raise IOError("connection closed early")
                        f.close()
                        self._complete()
                        return
                    limiter.acquire(len(data), self.stop)
                    f.write(data)
                    self.downloaded += len(data)
                    self._record()


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Download Manager")
        self.geometry("860x420")
        self.limiter = RateLimiter()
        self.items = {}  # tree iid -> Download
        self.folder = tk.StringVar(value=os.path.expanduser("~/Downloads"))
        self._build()
        self.after(250, self._refresh)
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW"

"""Download Manager GUI (tkinter). Run: python app.py"""
import json
import os
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

import downloader as dl

STATE_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".pydownloadmanager.json")


def human(n):
    n = float(n)
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if n < 1024:
            return f"{n:.0f} {unit}" if unit == "B" else f"{n:.1f} {unit}"
        n /= 1024
    return f"{n:.1f} TB"


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Download Manager")
        self.geometry("860x440")
        self.minsize(700, 320)

        self.limiter = dl.RateLimiter()
        self.items = {}       # tree iid -> Download
        self.last_sample = {}  # id -> (time, bytes)
        self.speeds = {}
        self.folder = tk.StringVar(
            value=os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Downloads"))
        self.url = tk.StringVar()
        self.limit_kb = tk.StringVar(value="0")

        self._build()
        self._load()
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._quit)
        self.after(500, self._tick)

    # --- layout ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _build(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="URL:").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        entry = ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.url)
        entry.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=4)
        entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.add())
        ttk.Button(top, text="Add", command=self.add).grid(row=0, column=2)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Save to:").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.folder).grid(
            row=1, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Browse…", command=self.browse).grid(row=1, column=2)
        top.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        bar = ttk.Frame(self, padding=(8, 0))
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        for text, cmd in (("Pause", self.pause), ("Resume", self.resume),
                          ("Remove", self.remove), ("Open folder", self.open_folder)):
            ttk.Button(bar, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 4))
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Set", command=self.apply_limit).pack(side="right")
        lim = ttk.Entry(bar, textvariable=self.limit_kb, width=8)
        lim.pack(side="right", padx=4)
        lim.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.apply_limit())
        ttk.Label(bar, text="Speed limit (KB/s, 0 = unlimited):").pack(side="right")

        cols = ("name", "size", "progress", "speed", "eta", "status")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=cols, show="headings",
                                 selectmode="extended")
        for c, text, w in (("name", "Name", 260), ("size", "Size", 120),
                           ("progress", "Progress", 80), ("speed", "Speed", 90),
                           ("eta", "ETA", 70), ("status", "Status", 160)):
            self.tree.heading(c, text=text)
            self.tree.column(c, width=w, anchor="w", stretch=(c in ("name", "status")))
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(self, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y", pady=8)
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=(8, 0), pady=8)

    # --- actions --------------------------------------------------------
    def browse(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.folder.get())
        if d:
            self.folder.set(d)

    def add(self, url=None, start=True):
        url = (url or self.url.get()).strip()
        if not url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid URL", "Enter an http:// or https:// URL.")
            return
        d = dl.Download(url, self.folder.get(), self.limiter)
        iid = self.tree.insert("", "end", values=("",) * 6)
        self.items[iid] = d
        self.url.set("")
        self._refresh(iid)
        if start:
            d.start()

    def _selected(self):
        return [(i, self.items[i]) for i in self.tree.selection()]

    def pause(self):
        for _, d in self._selected():
            d.pause()

    def resume(self):
        for _, d in self._selected():
            if d.state in (dl.PAUSED, dl.ERROR, dl.QUEUED):
                d.start()

    def remove(self):
        for iid, d in self._selected():
            d.cancel(delete_partial=d.state != dl.COMPLETED)
            self.tree.delete(iid)
            del self.items[iid]

    def open_folder(self):
        import subprocess
        import sys
        sel = self._selected()
        path = sel[0][1].folder if sel else self.folder.get()
        if not os.path.isdir(path):
            return
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            os.startfile(path)
        elif sys.platform == "darwin":
            subprocess.Popen(["open", path])
        else:
            subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", path])

    def apply_limit(self):
        try:
            kb = float(self.limit_kb.get())
            if kb < 0:
                raise ValueError
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid limit", "Enter a number ≥ 0.")
            return
        self.limiter.set_limit(kb * 1024)

    # --- display --------------------------------------------------------

"""A simple multi-server, multi-channel IRC client with a graphical window.

Run with:  python3 irc_client.py
Needs only Python 3 (tkinter is included with the python.org installer).

import json
import os

CONFIG_PATH = os.path.expanduser("~/.irc_client.json")

  /server host [port] [nick]   connect to another server (port 6697 uses TLS)
  /join #channel               join a channel
  /part [#channel]             leave a channel (or current one)
  /msg nick message            private message
  /query nick                  open a private chat window
  /me action                   action text
  /nick newnick                change nickname
  /close                       close the current tab
  /disconnect                  disconnect current server
  /quit                        exit the program
Click a server or channel in the left list to switch. Right-click for options."""


def parse(line):
    prefix = ""
    if line.startswith(":"):
        prefix, _, line = line[1:].partition(" ")
    if " :" in line:
        head, _, trailing = line.partition(" :")
        params = head.split() + [trailing]
    else:
        params = line.split()
    if not params:
        return prefix, "", []
    return prefix, params[0].upper(), params[1:]


def nick_of(prefix):
    return prefix.split("!")[0]


class Connection:
    def __init__(self, app, sid, host, port, tls, nick, password, channels):
        self.app, self.sid = app, sid
        self.host, self.port, self.tls = host, port, tls
        self.nick, self.password = nick, password
        self.channels = list(channels)
        self.sock = None
        self.alive = False

    def start(self):
        self.alive = True
        threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True).start()

    def _emit(self, kind, data=""):
        self.app.events.put((self.sid, kind, data))

    def _run(self):
        try:
            sock = socket.create_connection((self.host, self.port), timeout=20)
            if self.tls:
                sock = ssl.create_default_context().wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=self.host)
            sock.settimeout(None)
            self.sock = sock
            if self.password:
                self.send("PASS " + self.password)
            self.send("NICK " + self.nick)
            self.send("USER %s 0 * :%s" % (self.nick, self.nick))
            buf = b""
            while self.alive:
                chunk = sock.recv(4096)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                buf += chunk
                while b"\n" in buf:
                    raw, buf = buf.split(b"\n", 1)
                    self._emit("line", raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").rstrip("\r"))
            self._emit("closed", "Connection closed.")
        except Exception as e:
            self._emit("closed", "Connection error: %s" % e)
        finally:
            self.alive = False

    def send(self, text):
        text = text.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")
        try:
            self.sock.sendall(text.encode("utf-8")[:510] + b"\r\n")
        except Exception as e:
            self._emit("closed", "Send failed: %s" % e)

    def close(self):
        if self.alive:
            self.send("QUIT :Bye")
        self.alive = False
        try:
            self.sock.close()
        except Exception:
            pass

"""Network speed monitor for the macOS menu bar."""
import time

import psutil
import rumps


def format_speed(bytes_per_sec):
    """Turn a number of bytes per second into a short readable string."""
    value = bytes_per_sec * 8  # network speeds are usually shown in bits
    for unit in ("bps", "Kbps", "Mbps", "Gbps"):
        if value < 1000:
            return f"{value:.1f} {unit}" if unit != "bps" else f"{value:.0f} {unit}"
        value /= 1000
    return f"{value:.1f} Tbps"


def format_total(num_bytes):
    value = float(num_bytes)
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if value < 1024:
            return f"{value:.1f} {unit}"
        value /= 1024
    return f"{value:.1f} TB"


class SpeedMonitor(rumps.App):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__("Net", quit_button="Quit")
        self.down_item = rumps.MenuItem("Download: –")
        self.up_item = rumps.MenuItem("Upload: –")
        self.total_item = rumps.MenuItem("Total this session: –")
        self.menu = [self.down_item, self.up_item, self.total_item, None]

        start = psutil.net_io_counters()
        self.start_recv, self.start_sent = start.bytes_recv, start.bytes_sent
        self.last_recv, self.last_sent = start.bytes_recv, start.bytes_sent
        self.last_time = time.time()

        self.timer = rumps.Timer(self.update, 1)
        self.timer.start()

    def update(self, _):
        now = time.time()
        counters = psutil.net_io_counters()
        elapsed = max(now - self.last_time, 0.001)

        down = (counters.bytes_recv - self.last_recv) / elapsed
        up = (counters.bytes_sent - self.last_sent) / elapsed
        self.last_recv, self.last_sent, self.last_time = (
            counters.bytes_recv,
            counters.bytes_sent,
            now,
        )

        self.title = f"↓ {format_speed(down)}  ↑ {format_speed(up)}"
        self.down_item.title = f"Download: {format_speed(down)}"
        self.up_item.title = f"Upload: {format_speed(up)}"
        self.total_item.title = (
            f"This session: ↓ {format_total(counters.bytes_recv - self.start_recv)}"
            f"  ↑ {format_total(counters.bytes_sent - self.start_sent)}"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    SpeedMonitor().run()

#!/bin/bash
# Sets everything up the first time, then starts the speed monitor.
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1

if [ ! -d .venv ]; then
  echo "First-time setup (takes about a minute)..."
  python3 -m venv .venv || { echo "Python 3 is needed. Install it from python.org"; exit 1; }
  .venv/bin/pip install --quiet rumps psutil
fi

exec .venv/bin/python speed_monitor.py

    cargo build --release

Linux build/runtime dependencies (Debian/Ubuntu):

    sudo apt install libgtk-3-dev libxdo-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev

GNOME also needs the AppIndicator extension to display tray icons.

## Notes

- Loopback interfaces are excluded; all other interfaces are summed.
- Speeds are computed from interface byte counters between ticks (`INTERVAL` in `src/main.rs`).

"""Webhook tester: listens on a local port and shows incoming requests.

Standard library only (tkinter + http.server), so it starts fast and idles
at a small memory footprint. Run: python3 webhook_tester.py [port]
"""
import json
import queue
import sys
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from tkinter import ttk

DEFAULT_PORT = 8080
MAX_REQUESTS = 500          # oldest entries are dropped beyond this
MAX_BODY = 1024 * 1024      # bodies larger than 1 MiB are truncated
POLL_MS = 100

events = queue.Queue()


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"

    def _handle(self):
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
        except ValueError:
            length = 0
        body = self.rfile.read(min(length, MAX_BODY)) if length > 0 else b""
        remaining = length - len(body)
        while remaining > 0:  # drain the rest so the connection stays valid
            chunk = self.rfile.read(min(remaining, 65536))
            if not chunk:
                break
            remaining -= len(chunk)

        events.put({
            "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
            "method": self.command,
            "path": self.path,
            "client": self.client_address[0],
            "version": self.request_version,
            "headers": list(self.headers.items()),
            "body": body,
            "truncated": max(length - len(body), 0),
        })

        payload = b'{"status":"received"}'
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        if self.command != "HEAD":
            self.wfile.write(payload)

    do_GET = do_POST = do_PUT = do_PATCH = do_DELETE = do_OPTIONS = do_HEAD = _handle

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


def format_body(body, headers):
    if not body:
        return "(empty body)"
    text = body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    ctype = next((v for k, v in headers if k.lower() == "content-type"), "")
    if "json" in ctype:
        try:
            return json.dumps(json.loads(text), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return text

    def start_server(self):

"""Wi-Fi Analyzer: lists nearby networks and their signal strength."""
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

import scanner

COLUMNS = [
    ("ssid", "Network", 200, "w"),
    ("signal", "Signal", 150, "w"),
    ("pct", "%", 50, "e"),
    ("dbm", "dBm", 60, "e"),
    ("channel", "Channel", 70, "e"),
    ("band", "Band", 70, "w"),
    ("security", "Security", 130, "w"),
    ("bssid", "BSSID", 140, "w"),
]
REFRESH_MS = 5000


def bar(pct: int) -> str:
    n = round(pct / 10)
    return "█" * n + "░" * (10 - n)


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Wi-Fi Analyzer")
        self.geometry("900x420")
        self.networks = []
        self.sort_key, self.sort_rev = "pct", True
        self.busy = False

        top = ttk.Frame(self, padding=6)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        self.btn = ttk.Button(top, text="Scan now", command=self.refresh)
        self.btn.pack(side="left")
        self.auto = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        ttk.Checkbutton(top, text=f"Auto-refresh ({REFRESH_MS // 1000}s)",
                        variable=self.auto, command=self._schedule).pack(side="left", padx=10)
        self.status = ttk.Label(top, text="")
        self.status.pack(side="right")

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=[c[0] for c in COLUMNS],
                                 show="headings", selectmode="browse")
        for key, title, width, anchor in COLUMNS:
            self.tree.heading(key, text=title, command=lambda k=key: self.sort_by(k))
            self.tree.column(key, width=width, anchor=anchor)
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(self, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        self.refresh()
        self._schedule()

    def _schedule(self):
        if getattr(self, "_job", None):
            self.after_cancel(self._job)
            self._job = None
        if self.auto.get():
            self._job = self.after(REFRESH_MS, self._tick)

    def _tick(self):
        self.refresh()
        self._schedule()

    def refresh(self):
        if self.busy:
            return
        self.busy = True
        self.btn.state(["disabled"])
        self.status.config(text="Scanning…")
        threading.Thread(target=self._worker, daemon=True).start()

    def _worker(self):
        try:
            result, err = scanner.scan(), None
        except Exception as e:  # shown in the UI, never crash the thread
            result, err = None, str(e)
        self.after(0, self._done, result, err)

    def _done(self, result, err):
        self.busy = False
        self.btn.state(["!disabled"])
        if err:
            self.status.config(text=f"Error: {err}")
            return
        self.networks = result
        self.status.config(text=f"{len(result)} networks")
        self.render()

    def sort_by(self, key):
        self.sort_rev = not self.sort_rev if key == self.sort_key else key in ("pct", "signal", "dbm")
        self.sort_key = "pct" if key == "signal" else key
        self.render()

    def _value(self, n, key):
        return {"ssid": n.ssid.lower(), "pct": n.signal_pct, "dbm": n.dbm if n.dbm is not None else -999,
                "channel": int(n.channel) if n.channel.isdigit() else 0, "band": n.band,
                "security": n.security, "bssid": n.bssid}[key]

    def render(self):
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        selected = self.tree.item(sel[0], "values")[-1] + self.tree.item(sel[0], "values")[0] if sel else None
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        for n in sorted(self.networks, key=lambda n: self._value(n, self.sort_key), reverse=self.sort_rev):
            iid = self.tree.insert("", "end", values=(
                n.ssid, bar(n.signal_pct), n.signal_pct,
                "" if n.dbm is None else n.dbm, n.channel, n.band, n.security, n.bssid))
            if selected and n.bssid + n.ssid == selected:
                self.tree.selection_set(iid)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    App().mainloop()

"""Unit & Currency Converter - Tkinter desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)."""

import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk

import converter


def format_number(x):
    if x == 0:
        return "0"
    if abs(x) >= 1e12 or abs(x) < 1e-6:
        return f"{x:.8e}"
    return f"{x:,.10g}" if abs(x) >= 1e10 else f"{x:,.8f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


class App(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master):
        super().__init__(master, padding=16)
        self.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.rates = converter.CurrencyRates()

        self.category = tk.StringVar(value="Length")
        self.value = tk.StringVar(value="1")
        self.from_unit = tk.StringVar()
        self.to_unit = tk.StringVar()
        self.result = tk.StringVar()
        self.status = tk.StringVar()

        self.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        ttk.Label(self, text="Category").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        cat = ttk.Combobox(self, textvariable=self.category, values=converter.categories(),
                           state="readonly")
        cat.grid(row=0, column=1, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", pady=4)
        cat.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.on_category())

        ttk.Label(self, text="Value").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        entry = ttk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.value, font=("TkDefaultFont", 14))
        entry.grid(row=1, column=1, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", pady=4)
        entry.focus()

        ttk.Label(self, text="From").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        self.from_box = ttk.Combobox(self, textvariable=self.from_unit, state="readonly", width=22)
        self.from_box.grid(row=2, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=4)
        ttk.Button(self, text="⇄", width=3, command=self.swap).grid(row=2, column=2, rowspan=2, padx=8)
        ttk.Label(self, text="To").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        self.to_box = ttk.Combobox(self, textvariable=self.to_unit, state="readonly", width=22)
        self.to_box.grid(row=3, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=4)

        ttk.Label(self, textvariable=self.result, font=("TkDefaultFont", 18, "bold"),
                  wraplength=420).grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=(16, 4))
        row = ttk.Frame(self)
        row.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew")
        ttk.Button(row, text="Copy result", command=self.copy).pack(side="left")
        self.refresh_btn = ttk.Button(row, text="Refresh rates", command=self.refresh_rates)
        ttk.Label(self, textvariable=self.status, foreground="gray").grid(
            row=6, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=(12, 0))

        for var in (self.value, self.from_unit, self.to_unit):
            var.trace_add("write", lambda *a: self.update_result())
        self.on_category()
        self.refresh_rates()

    def on_category(self):
        cat = self.category.get()
        if cat == "Currency":
            units = self.rates.codes()
            self.refresh_btn.pack(side="left", padx=8)
            self.status.set(self.rates.source)
            defaults = ("USD", "EUR")
        else:
            units = converter.units_for(cat)
            self.refresh_btn.pack_forget()
            self.status.set("")
            defaults = (units[0], units[1] if len(units) > 1 else units[0])
        self.from_box["values"] = units
        self.to_box["values"] = units
        self.from_unit.set(defaults[0])
        self.to_unit.set(defaults[1])

    def swap(self):
        a, b = self.from_unit.get(), self.to_unit.get()
        self.from_unit.set(b)
        self.to_unit.set(a)

    def update_result(self):
        text = self.value.get().strip().replace(",", "")
        f, t = self.from_unit.get(), self.to_unit.get()
        if not text or not f or not t:
            self.result.set("")
            return
        try:
            x = float(text)
            if self.category.get() == "Currency":
                out = self.rates.convert(x, f, t)
            else:
                out = converter.convert_unit(self.category.get(), x, f, t)
            self.result.set(f"{format_number(out)} {t}")
        except (ValueError, KeyError) as e:
            self.result.set("Invalid input" if "could not convert" in str(e) else str(e))

    def copy(self):
        text = self.result.get().rsplit(" ", 1)[0]
        self.clipboard_clear()
        self.clipboard_append(text.replace(",", ""))

    def refresh_rates(self):
        self.status.set("Updating currency rates…") if self.category.get() == "Currency" else None
        force = self.refresh_btn.winfo_ismapped()

        def work():
            self.rates.load(force_refresh=force)
            self.after(0, self.rates_loaded)

        threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True).start()

    def rates_loaded(self):
        if self.category.get() == "Currency":
            f, t = self.from_unit.get(), self.to_unit.get()
            self.on_category()
            if f in self.rates.rates and t in self.rates.rates:
                self.from_unit.set(f)
                self.to_unit.set(t)
        self.update_result()


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("Unit & Currency Converter")
    root.minsize(480, 340)
    App(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Small, fast unit and currency converter. Standard library only (tkinter)."""

import json
import os
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from urllib.request import urlopen

RATES_URL = "https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/latest?base=USD"
CACHE_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".cache", "unitconv", "rates.json")
CACHE_MAX_AGE = 12 * 3600

# Each category maps unit name -> factor to the base unit (first entry).
UNITS = {
    "Length": {
        "meter": 1, "kilometer": 1000, "centimeter": 0.01, "millimeter": 0.001,
        "mile": 1609.344, "yard": 0.9144, "foot": 0.3048, "inch": 0.0254,
        "nautical mile": 1852,
    },
    "Mass": {
        "kilogram": 1, "gram": 0.001, "milligram": 1e-6, "tonne": 1000,
        "pound": 0.45359237, "ounce": 0.028349523125, "stone": 6.35029318,
    },
    "Volume": {
        "liter": 1, "milliliter": 0.001, "cubic meter": 1000,
        "US gallon": 3.785411784, "US quart": 0.946352946, "US pint": 0.473176473,
        "US cup": 0.2365882365, "US fluid ounce": 0.0295735295625,
        "tablespoon (US)": 0.01478676478125, "teaspoon (US)": 0.00492892159375,
        "imperial gallon": 4.54609,
    },
    "Area": {
        "square meter": 1, "square kilometer": 1e6, "square centimeter": 1e-4,
        "hectare": 1e4, "acre": 4046.8564224, "square mile": 2589988.110336,
        "square foot": 0.09290304, "square inch": 0.00064516,
    },
    "Speed": {
        "meter/second": 1, "kilometer/hour": 1 / 3.6, "mile/hour": 0.44704,
        "knot": 1852 / 3600, "foot/second": 0.3048,
    },
    "Time": {
        "second": 1, "millisecond": 0.001, "minute": 60, "hour": 3600,
        "day": 86400, "week": 604800, "year (365 d)": 31536000,
    },
    "Data": {
        "byte": 1, "kilobyte (1000)": 1e3, "megabyte (1000)": 1e6,
        "gigabyte (1000)": 1e9, "terabyte (1000)": 1e12,
        "kibibyte (1024)": 1024, "mebibyte (1024)": 1024**2,
        "gibibyte (1024)": 1024**3, "tebibyte (1024)": 1024**4, "bit": 0.125,
    },
    "Temperature": {"Celsius": None, "Fahrenheit": None, "Kelvin": None},
    "Currency": {},  # filled from rates
}

# Offline fallback (approximate, units per 1 USD). Replaced by live rates when available.
FALLBACK_RATES = {
    "USD": 1.0, "EUR": 0.86, "GBP": 0.75, "JPY": 150.0, "CAD": 1.38,
    "AUD": 1.52, "CHF": 0.80, "CNY": 7.2, "INR": 88.0, "UAH": 41.5,
    "PLN": 3.65, "MXN": 18.5, "BRL": 5.4,
}


def to_celsius(v, unit):
    if unit == "Fahrenheit":
        return (v - 32) * 5 / 9
    if unit == "Kelvin":
        return v - 273.15
    return v


def from_celsius(c, unit):
    if unit == "Fahrenheit":
        return c * 9 / 5 + 32
    if unit == "Kelvin":
        return c + 273.15
    return c


def convert(value, category, src, dst, rates):
    if category == "Temperature":
        return from_celsius(to_celsius(value, src), dst)
    if category == "Currency":
        return value / rates[src] * rates[dst]
    table = UNITS[category]
    return value * table[src] / table[dst]


def load_cached_rates():
    """Return (rates, timestamp) or (None, 0)."""
    try:
        with open(CACHE_PATH) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        return data["rates"], data["time"]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return None, 0


def fetch_rates():
    with urlopen(RATES_URL, timeout=8) as r:
        rates = json.load(r)["rates"]
    rates["USD"] = 1.0
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(CACHE_PATH), exist_ok=True)
        with open(CACHE_PATH, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"rates": rates, "time": time.time()}, f)
    except OSError:
        pass
    return rates


class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("Converter")
        root.resizable(False, False)

        self.rates, stamp = load_cached_rates()
        self.rates = self.rates or dict(FALLBACK_RATES)
        self.rate_note = "cached rates" if stamp else "offline approximate rates"
        self.fetched = None  # set by the worker thread

        self.category = tk.StringVar(value="Length")
        self.in_val = tk.StringVar(value="1")
        self.out_val = tk.StringVar()
        self.in_unit = tk.StringVar()
        self.out_unit = tk.StringVar()
        self.status = tk.StringVar()

        pad = {"padx": 10, "pady": 6}
        frm = ttk.Frame(root, padding=8)
        frm.grid()

        self.cat_box = ttk.Combobox(
            frm, textvariable=self.category, state="readonly", width=30,
            values=list(UNITS),
        )
        self.cat_box.grid(row=0, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", **pad)

        self.in_entry = ttk.Entry(frm, textvariable=self.in_val, width=18)
        self.in_entry.grid(row=1, column=0, **pad)
        self.in_box = ttk.Combobox(frm, textvariable=self.in_unit, state="readonly", width=20)
        self.in_box.grid(row=1, column=1, columnspan=2, **pad)

        ttk.Button(frm, text="⇅ Swap", command=self.swap).grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=3, pady=2)

        self.out_entry = ttk.Entry(frm, textvariable=self.out_val, width=18, state="readonly")
        self.out_entry.grid(row=3, column=0, **pad)
        self.out_box = ttk.Combobox(frm, textvariable=self.out_unit, state="readonly", width=20)
        self.out_box.grid(row=3, column=1, columnspan=2, **pad)

        ttk.Label(frm, textvariable=self.status, foreground="#666").grid(
            row=4, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", **pad)

        self.cat_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.set_category())
        self.in_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.update())
        self.out_box.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.update())
        self.in_val.trace_add("write", lambda *a: self.update())

        self.set_category()
        self.in_entry.focus_set()
        # Network work starts only after the window is up.
        root.after(50, self.maybe_fetch, stamp)

    # --- currency handling ----------------------------------------

"""Desktop password manager (Tkinter). Run: python app.py [vault_file]"""
import os
import sys
import time
import tkinter as tk
import uuid
from tkinter import messagebox, simpledialog, ttk

from vault import CorruptVault, Vault, WrongPassword, generate_password

DEFAULT_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".passwords.vault")
AUTOLOCK_SECONDS = 300
CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_SECONDS = 20
MIN_MASTER_LEN = 8


class EntryDialog(tk.Toplevel):
    def __init__(self, parent, entry=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title("Edit entry" if entry else "New entry")
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        entry = entry or {}
        self.vars = {k: tk.StringVar(value=entry.get(k, "")) for k in ("title", "username", "password", "url")}
        for i, (key, label) in enumerate([("title", "Title"), ("username", "Username"),
                                          ("password", "Password"), ("url", "URL")]):
            ttk.Label(self, text=label).grid(row=i, column=0, sticky="e", padx=6, pady=4)
            e = ttk.Entry(self, textvariable=self.vars[key], width=36,
                          show="•" if key == "password" else "")
            e.grid(row=i, column=1, padx=6, pady=4)
            if key == "password":
                self.pw_entry = e
        ttk.Label(self, text="Notes").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="ne", padx=6, pady=4)
        self.notes = tk.Text(self, width=36, height=5)
        self.notes.grid(row=4, column=1, padx=6, pady=4)
        self.notes.insert("1.0", entry.get("notes", ""))

        tools = ttk.Frame(self)
        tools.grid(row=2, column=2, padx=4)
        self.show = tk.BooleanVar()
        ttk.Checkbutton(tools, text="Show", variable=self.show, command=self._toggle).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(tools, text="Generate", command=self._gen).pack(side="left")

        btns = ttk.Frame(self)
        btns.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=3, pady=8)
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Save", command=self._ok).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Cancel", command=self.destroy).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda _: self.destroy())
        self.transient(parent)
        self.grab_set()
        self.wait_window()

    def _toggle(self):
        self.pw_entry.config(show="" if self.show.get() else "•")

    def _gen(self):
        self.vars["password"].set(generate_password())
        self.show.set(True)
        self._toggle()

    def _ok(self):
        if not self.vars["title"].get().strip():
            messagebox.showwarning("Missing title", "Please enter a title.", parent=self)
            return
        self.result = {k: v.get() for k, v in self.vars.items()}
        self.result["title"] = self.result["title"].strip()
        self.result["notes"] = self.notes.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        self.destroy()


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self, path):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Password Vault")
        self.geometry("720x420")
        self.vault = Vault(path)
        self.last_activity = time.time()
        self.clip_token = None
        self.search = tk.StringVar()
        self.search.trace_add("write", lambda *_: self.refresh())
        self._build()
        for ev in ("<Key>", "<Button>", "<Motion>"):
            self.bind_all(ev, self._touch, add="+")
        self.after(1000, self._tick)
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._quit)
        self.withdraw()
        if not self.login():
            self.destroy()
            return
        self.deiconify()
        self.refresh()

    # ---- UI ----
    def _build(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=6)
        ttk.Label(top, text="Search").pack(side="left")
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.search).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6)
        for text, cmd in [("Add", self.add), ("Edit", self.edit), ("Delete", self.delete),
                          ("Copy password", self.copy_password), ("Lock", self.lock)]:
            ttk.Button(top, text=text, command=cmd).pack(side="left", padx=2)

        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self, columns=("username", "url"), selectmode="browse")
        self.tree.heading("#0", text="Title")
        self.tree.heading("username", text="Username")
        self.tree.heading("url", text="URL")
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8)
        self.tree.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _: self.edit())
        self.status = ttk.Label(self, text="", anchor="w")
        self.status.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=4)

        menu = tk.Menu(self)
        m = tk.Menu(menu, tearoff=0)
        m.add_command(label="Change master password…", command=self.change_master)
        m.add_command(label="Lock", command=self.lock)
        m.add_command(label="Quit", command=self._quit)
        menu.add_cascade(label="Vault", menu=m)
        self.config(menu=menu)

    def refresh(self):
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        q = self.search.get().lower()
        for e in sorted(self.vault.entries, key=lambda e: e["title"].lower()):
            if q and q not in e["title"].lower() and q not in e.get("username", "").lower() \
                    and q not in e.get("url", "").lower():
                continue
            self.tree.insert("", "end", iid=e["id"], text=e["title"],
                             values=(e.get("username", ""), e.get("url", "")))

    def _selected(self):
        sel = self.tree.selection()
        if not sel:
            messagebox.showinfo("No selection", "Select an entry first.")
            return None
        return next(e for e in self.vault.entries if e["id"] == sel[0])

    # ---- auth ----
    def login(self) -> bool:
        path = self.vault.path
        if not Vault.exists(path):
            while True:
                pw = simpledialog.askstring("Create vault", f"Choose a master password\nfor {path}:", show="•")
                if pw is None:
                    return False

I wrote the password manager to `/private/tmp/fwd-o2mi5_0h/password_manager.py`. I haven't run it, because I can't run programs in this session. Please try it with a throwaway entry first.

**To run it**
1. Open the Terminal app.
2. Install the one add-on it needs. You only do this once:
   ```
   pip3 install cryptography
   ```
3. Start it:
   ```
   cd /private/tmp/fwd-o2mi5_0h
   python3 password_manager.py
   ```
   `/private/tmp` can get cleared by macOS. Move the folder somewhere permanent, such as your Documents folder, before you store real passwords.

**What it does**
- **First run:** it asks you to choose a master password and creates the encrypted file `vault.enc` next to the script.
- **Menu:** you can list, show, add, edit and delete entries. Each entry holds a name, username, password, website and notes.
- **Passwords:** it can generate a strong random password for you.
- **Copying:** it can copy a password to the clipboard and clear it when you press Enter.
- **Master password:** you can change it from the menu.

**Security**
- The master password is turned into an encryption key with scrypt, which is deliberately slow to make guessing hard.
- Everything is encrypted with Fernet (AES) from the `cryptography` package. Nothing is saved in plain text.
- The vault file is readable only by your user account. Each save replaces the file in one step, so a crash can't leave it half-written.

**Things to know**
- **Master password:** if you forget it, your passwords can't be recovered. Use a long phrase you'll remember.
- **Backups:** copy `vault.enc` somewhere safe from time to time. It's useless without your master password, so backing it up is safe.
- **Scope:** this is a simple personal tool. It has no browser autofill and no syncing between devices.

"""Tkinter GUI for the password manager. Run: python app.py [vault_path]"""
import os
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox, simpledialog, ttk

from vault import Vault, VaultError, WrongPassword, default_path, generate_password

AUTOLOCK_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000
CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_MS = 20 * 1000
MIN_MASTER_LEN = 8


class EntryDialog(tk.Toplevel):
    def __init__(self, parent, entry=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.title("Edit entry" if entry else "New entry")
        self.transient(parent)
        self.resizable(False, False)
        self.result = None
        entry = entry or {}
        self.entry = entry

        self.vars = {}
        frm = ttk.Frame(self, padding=12)
        frm.pack()
        for row, (key, label) in enumerate(
            [("title", "Title"), ("username", "Username"), ("password", "Password"), ("url", "URL")]
        ):
            ttk.Label(frm, text=label).grid(row=row, column=0, sticky="e", pady=3, padx=(0, 8))
            var = tk.StringVar(value=entry.get(key, ""))
            self.vars[key] = var
            e = ttk.Entry(frm, textvariable=var, width=36, show="•" if key == "password" else "")
            e.grid(row=row, column=1, sticky="w")
            if key == "password":
                self.pw_entry = e
        btns = ttk.Frame(frm)
        btns.grid(row=2, column=2, padx=(6, 0))
        ttk.Button(btns, text="Generate", command=self._generate).pack(side="left")
        self.show = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        ttk.Checkbutton(btns, text="Show", variable=self.show, command=self._toggle).pack(side="left")

        ttk.Label(frm, text="Notes").grid(row=4, column=0, sticky="ne", pady=3, padx=(0, 8))
        self.notes = tk.Text(frm, width=36, height=5)
        self.notes.grid(row=4, column=1, sticky="w")
        self.notes.insert("1.0", entry.get("notes", ""))

        bar = ttk.Frame(frm)
        bar.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=3, pady=(10, 0), sticky="e")
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Cancel", command=self.destroy).pack(side="right", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Save", command=self._save).pack(side="right")

        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda _: self.destroy())
        self.grab_set()
        self.wait_visibility()
        self.wait_window()

    def _toggle(self):
        self.pw_entry.config(show="" if self.show.get() else "•")

    def _generate(self):
        self.vars["password"].set(generate_password())
        self.show.set(True)
        self._toggle()

    def _save(self):
        if not self.vars["title"].get().strip():
            messagebox.showwarning("Missing title", "Please enter a title.", parent=self)
            return
        result = dict(self.entry)
        result.update({k: v.get() for k, v in self.vars.items()})
        result["notes"] = self.notes.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        self.result = result
        self.destroy()


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self, path):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Password Manager")
        self.geometry("720x440")
        self.minsize(560, 320)
        self.path = path
        self.vault = None
        self._lock_job = None
        self._clip_job = None
        self.shown_id = None
        for ev in ("<Key>", "<Button>", "<Motion>"):
            self.bind_all(ev, self._activity, add="+")
        self.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._quit)
        self.show_unlock()

    # --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _clear(self):
        for w in self.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()

    def _activity(self, _=None):
        if self.vault is None:
            return
        if self._lock_job:
            self.after_cancel(self._lock_job)
        self._lock_job = self.after(AUTOCLOCK_MS if False else AUTOLOCK_MS, self.lock)

    def _quit(self):
        self._clear_clipboard()
        self.destroy()

    # --- unlock screen ---------------------------------------------------
    def show_unlock(self):
        self._clear()
        creating = not os.path.exists(self.path)
        frm = ttk.Frame(self, padding=30)
        frm.place(relx=0.5, rely=0.5, anchor="center")
        ttk.Label(frm, text="Create new vault" if creating else "Unlock vault",
                  font=("TkDefaultFont", 16, "bold")).grid(columnspan=2, pady=(0, 12))
        ttk.Label(frm, text="Master password").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="e", padx=6, pady=3)
        self.pw1 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="•", width=30)
        self.pw1.grid(row=1, column=1)
        self.pw2 = None
        if creating:
            ttk.Label(frm, text="Confirm").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", padx=6, pady=3)
            self.pw2 = ttk.Entry(frm, show="•", width=30)
            self.pw2.grid(row=2, column=1)
            ttk.Label(frm, text=f"Min {MIN_MASTER_LEN} characters. If you forget it, the data cannot be recovered.",
                      foreground="gray").grid(row=3, columnspan=2, pady=4)
        ttk.Button(frm, text="Create" if creating else "Unlock", command=self._do_unlock).grid(
            row=4, columnspan=2, pady=10)
        ttk.Label(frm, text=self.path, foreground="gray").grid(row=5, columnspan=2)
        self.pw1.focus_set()
        self.bind("<Return>", lambda _: self._do_unlock())

    def _do_unlock(self):
        pw = self.pw1.get()
        try:
            if self.pw2 is not None:
                if len(pw) < MIN_MASTER_LEN:

                if pw != self.pw2.get():

            else:
                self.config(cursor="watch"); self.update_idletasks()
                self.vault = Vault.open(self.path, pw)

"""Lightweight password manager UI (Tkinter). Run: python3 app.py [vault-path]"""
import os
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox, ttk

from vault import Vault, VaultError, generate_password, new_entry

DEFAULT_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".pwvault", "vault.pm")
CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_MS = 20_000
IDLE_LOCK_MS = 5 * 60_000


class App:
    def __init__(self, root, path):
        self.root, self.path = root, path
        self.vault = None
        self.current = None
        self.idle_job = None
        self.clip_job = None
        root.title("Password Manager")
        root.geometry("720x440")
        root.minsize(560, 360)
        for ev in ("<Key>", "<Button>", "<Motion>"):
            root.bind_all(ev, self._activity, add="+")
        self.show_login()

    # ---------- helpers
    def _clear(self):
        for w in self.root.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()

    def _activity(self, _e=None):
        if self.vault is None:
            return
        if self.idle_job:
            self.root.after_cancel(self.idle_job)
        self.idle_job = self.root.after(IDLE_LOCK_MS, self.lock)

    def copy(self, text):
        self.root.clipboard_clear()
        self.root.clipboard_append(text)
        if self.clip_job:
            self.root.after_cancel(self.clip_job)
        self.clip_job = self.root.after(CLIPBOARD_CLEAR_MS, lambda: self._clear_clip(text))

    def _clear_clip(self, text):
        try:
            if self.root.clipboard_get() == text:
                self.root.clipboard_clear()
        except tk.TclError:
            pass

    # ---------- login
    def show_login(self):
        self._clear()
        creating = not Vault.exists(self.path)
        f = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=30)
        f.place(relx=0.5, rely=0.5, anchor="center")
        ttk.Label(f, text="Create new vault" if creating else "Unlock vault",
                  font=("TkDefaultFont", 14, "bold")).grid(columnspan=2, pady=(0, 10))
        ttk.Label(f, text="Master password").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="e", padx=5, pady=3)
        pw = ttk.Entry(f, show="•", width=28)
        pw.grid(row=1, column=1, pady=3)
        pw.focus_set()
        pw2 = None
        if creating:
            ttk.Label(f, text="Confirm").grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="e", padx=5, pady=3)
            pw2 = ttk.Entry(f, show="•", width=28)
            pw2.grid(row=2, column=1, pady=3)
        status = ttk.Label(f, foreground="#b00020")
        status.grid(row=3, columnspan=2, pady=4)

        def submit(_e=None):
            p = pw.get()
            if creating:
                if len(p) < 8:
                    return status.config(text="Use at least 8 characters.")
                if p != pw2.get():
                    return status.config(text="Passwords do not match.")
            status.config(text="Working…")
            f.update_idletasks()
            try:
                self.vault = Vault.create(self.path, p) if creating else Vault.open(self.path, p)
            except VaultError as e:
                return status.config(text=str(e))
            except OSError as e:
                return status.config(text=f"File error: {e}")
            self.show_main()

        btn = ttk.Button(f, text="Create" if creating else "Unlock", command=submit)
        btn.grid(row=4, columnspan=2, pady=6)
        self.root.bind("<Return>", submit)
        ttk.Label(f, text=self.path, foreground="gray").grid(row=5, columnspan=2)

    def lock(self):
        if self.vault:
            self.vault.lock()
        self.vault = None
        self.current = None
        if self.idle_job:
            self.root.after_cancel(self.idle_job)
            self.idle_job = None
        self.root.clipboard_clear()
        self.show_login()

    # ---------- main
    def show_main(self):
        self._clear()
        self.root.unbind("<Return>")
        self._activity()
        top = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=6)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        self.q = tk.StringVar()
        self.q.trace_add("write", lambda *_: self.refresh())
        ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.q).pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True)
        ttk.Button(top, text="New", command=lambda: self.edit(None)).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(top, text="Lock", command=self.lock).pack(side="left")

        body = ttk.PanedWindow(self.root, orient="horizontal")
        body.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=6, pady=(0, 6))
        self.lb = tk.Listbox(body, exportselection=False, activestyle="none")
        self.lb.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", self.on_select)
        body.add(self.lb, weight=1)
        self.detail = ttk.Frame(body, padding=10)
        body.add(self.detail, weight=2)
        self.shown = []
        self.refresh()

    def refresh(self):
        self.shown = self.vault.search(self.q.get())
        self.lb.delete(0, "end")
        for e in self.shown:
            self.lb.insert("end", e["title"] or "(untitled)")
        sel = next((i for i, e in enumerate(self.shown)
                    if self.current and e["id"] == self.current["id"]), None)
        if sel is not None:
            self.lb.selection_set(sel)
        else:
            self.current = None
        self.render_detail()

    def on_select(self, _e=None):
        s = self.lb.curselection()
        if s:
            self.current = self.shown[s[0]]
            self.render_detail()

    def render_detail(self):
        for w in self.detail.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        e = self.current
        if not e:
            ttk.Label(self.detail, text="Select or add an entry.", foreground="gray").pack()
            return
        ttk.Label(self.detail, text=e["title"], font=("TkDefaultFont", 13, "bold")).pack(anchor="w")
        grid = ttk.Frame(self.detail)
        grid.pack(fill="x", pady=8)
        grid.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        self._row(grid, 0, "Username", e["username"], copy=True)
        self._row(grid, 1, "Password", e["password"], copy=True, s

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Password Generator: a desktop app with configurable rules (tkinter, stdlib only)."""

import math
import secrets
import string
import tkinter as tk
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from tkinter import ttk

AMBIGUOUS = "O0oIl1|`'\""
DEFAULT_SYMBOLS = "!@#$%^&*()-_=+[]{};:,.<>?/~"
RNG = secrets.SystemRandom()


class RuleError(ValueError):
    """Raised when the configured rules cannot be satisfied."""


@dataclass
class Rules:
    length: int = 16
    lower: bool = True
    upper: bool = True
    digits: bool = True
    symbols: bool = True
    min_lower: int = 1
    min_upper: int = 1
    min_digits: int = 1
    min_symbols: int = 1
    symbol_set: str = DEFAULT_SYMBOLS
    exclude_ambiguous: bool = False
    exclude_chars: str = ""
    no_repeats: bool = False
    start_with_letter: bool = False
    pools: dict = field(init=False, default_factory=dict)

    def build_pools(self):
        """Return {name: (chars, minimum)} for enabled classes, after exclusions."""
        banned = set(self.exclude_chars)
        if self.exclude_ambiguous:
            banned |= set(AMBIGUOUS)
        spec = [
            ("lower", self.lower, string.ascii_lowercase, self.min_lower),
            ("upper", self.upper, string.ascii_uppercase, self.min_upper),
            ("digits", self.digits, string.digits, self.min_digits),
            ("symbols", self.symbols, self.symbol_set, self.min_symbols),
        ]
        pools = {}
        for name, enabled, chars, minimum in spec:
            if not enabled:
                continue
            chars = "".join(dict.fromkeys(c for c in chars if c not in banned))
            if not chars:
                raise RuleError(f"No characters left in '{name}' after exclusions.")
            pools[name] = (chars, max(0, minimum))
        if not pools:
            raise RuleError("Enable at least one character type.")
        return pools


def pool_size(rules):
    pools = rules.build_pools()
    return len(set("".join(c for c, _ in pools.values())))


def generate(rules):
    pools = rules.build_pools()
    if rules.length < 1:
        raise RuleError("Length must be at least 1.")

    mins = {n: m for n, (_, m) in pools.items()}
    if rules.start_with_letter:
        letters = [n for n in ("lower", "upper") if n in pools]
        if not letters:
            raise RuleError("'Start with a letter' needs lowercase or uppercase enabled.")
        mins[letters[0]] = max(mins[letters[0]], 1)

    if sum(mins.values()) > rules.length:
        raise RuleError("Minimum counts add up to more than the length.")

    union = "".join(dict.fromkeys("".join(c for c, _ in pools.values())))
    if rules.no_repeats and rules.length > len(union):
        raise RuleError(f"No-repeat needs length <= {len(union)} available characters.")

    chars = []
    used = set()

    def pick(source):
        options = [c for c in source if c not in used] if rules.no_repeats else source
        if not options:
            raise RuleError("Rules are too strict: ran out of unique characters.")
        c = secrets.choice(options)
        used.add(c)
        chars.append(c)

    # Satisfy minimums with the smallest pools first so no-repeat can't starve them.
    for name in sorted(pools, key=lambda n: len(pools[n][0])):
        for _ in range(mins[name]):
            pick(pools[name][0])
    while len(chars) < rules.length:
        pick(union)

    RNG.shuffle(chars)
    if rules.start_with_letter and not chars[0].isalpha():
        i = next(i for i, c in enumerate(chars) if c.isalpha())
        chars[0], chars[i] = chars[i], chars[0]
    return "".join(chars)


def entropy_bits(rules):
    return rules.length * math.log2(max(pool_size(rules), 2))


def strength_label(bits):
    for limit, label in ((40, "Very weak"), (60, "Weak"), (80, "Fair"), (110, "Strong")):
        if bits < limit:
            return label
    return "Very strong"


class App(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, root):
        super().__init__(root, padding=14)
        self.grid(sticky="nsew")
        root.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        root.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.root = root
        self.clear_job = None

        self.length = tk.IntVar(value=16)
        self.count = tk.IntVar(value=1)
        self.flags = {k: tk.BooleanVar(value=True) for k in ("lower", "upper", "digits", "symbols")}
        self.mins = {k: tk.IntVar(value=1) for k in self.flags}
        self.ambiguous = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.no_repeats = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.start_letter = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.symbol_set = tk.StringVar(value=DEFAULT_SYMBOLS)
        self.exclude = tk.StringVar()
        self.status = tk.StringVar()
        self.strength = tk.StringVar()

        self._build()
        self.generate()

    def _build(self):
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        out = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Generated passwords", padding=8)
        out.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        out.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.output = tk.Text(out, height=5, width=48, font=("Menlo", 14), wrap="none")
        self.output.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        self.output.configure(state="disabled")
        ttk.Label(out, textvariable=self.strength).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))

        rules = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Rules", padding=8)
        rules.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=10)
        rules.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(rules, text="Length").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        ttk.Scale(rules, from_=4, to=128, orient="horizontal",
                  command=lambda v: self.length.set(round(float(v)))
                  ).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=8)
        self.length_scale = rules.grid_slaves(row=0, column=1)[0]
        self.length_scale.set(16)
        ttk.Spinbox(rules, from_=1, to=256, width=5, textvariable=self.length,
                    command=self._sync_sca
