        self.sans = []
        self.human_white = True
        self.selected = None
        self.targets = set()
        self.last = None
        self.token = 0
        self.thinking = False
        self.result = None
        self.results = queue.Queue()

        size = 8 * SQ + 2 * MARGIN
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(root, width=size, height=size, highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.grid(row=0, column=0, padx=10, pady=10)
        self.canvas.bind("<Button-1>", self.on_click)

        side = ttk.Frame(root, padding=(0, 10, 10, 10))
        side.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
        self.status = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Label(side, textvariable=self.status, font=(None, 13, "bold"), wraplength=240).pack(anchor="w")

        opts = ttk.Frame(side)
        opts.pack(fill="x", pady=8)
        ttk.Label(opts, text="Play as").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.side_var = tk.StringVar(value="White")
        ttk.Combobox(opts, textvariable=self.side_var, values=("White", "Black"),
                     state="readonly", width=10).grid(row=0, column=1, padx=6, pady=2)
        ttk.Label(opts, text="Level").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.level_var = tk.StringVar(value="Medium")
        ttk.Combobox(opts, textvariable=self.level_var, values=list(LEVELS),
                     state="readonly", width=10).grid(row=1, column=1, padx=6, pady=2)

        buttons = ttk.Frame(side)
        buttons.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Button(buttons, text="New game", command=self.new_game).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(buttons, text="Undo", command=self.undo).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        ttk.Button(buttons, text="Copy PGN", command=self.copy_pgn).pack(side="left")

        ttk.Label(side, text="Move history", font=(None, 11, "bold")).pack(anchor="w", pady=(12, 2))
        frame = ttk.Frame(side)
        frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(frame, columns=("n", "w", "b"), show="headings", height=18,
                                 selectmode="none")
        for col, text, width in (("n", "#", 40), ("w", "White", 90), ("b", "Black", 90)):
            self.tree.heading(col, text=text)
            self.tree.column(col, width=width, anchor="w")
        bar = ttk.Scrollbar(frame, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=bar.set)
        self.tree.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        bar.pack(side="right", fill="y")

        self.new_game()

    # ---- game flow -----------------------------------------------------
    def new_game(self):
        self.token += 1
        self.thinking = False
        self.pos = Position()
        self.sans = []
        self.human_white = self.side_var.get() == "White"
        self.selected, self.targets, self.last, self.result = None, set(), None, None
        self.refresh_history()
        self.after_move()

    def undo(self):
        self.token += 1
        self.thinking = False
        if not self.pos.stack:
            return
        self.undo_ply()
        while self.pos.white != self.human_white and self.pos.stack:
            self.undo_ply()
        self.selected, self.targets, self.result = None, set(), None
        self.last = None
        self.refresh_history()
        self.after_move()

    def undo_ply(self):
        self.pos.unmake()
        self.sans.pop()

    def play(self, move):
        self.sans.append(self.pos.san(move))
        self.pos.make(move)
        self.last = (move[0], move[1])
        self.selected, self.targets = None, set()
        self.refresh_history()
        self.after_move()

    def after_move(self):
        state = self.pos.status()
        if state:
            self.thinking = False
            if state == "checkmate":
                human_won = self.pos.white != self.human_white
                self.status.set("Checkmate - you win!" if human_won else "Checkmate - computer wins")
                self.result = "1-0" if not self.pos.white else "0-1"
            else:
                self.status.set(MESSAGES[state])
                self.result = "1/2-1/2"
        elif self.pos.white != self.human_white:
            self.start_ai()
        else:
            self.status.set("Your move" + (" (check)" if self.pos.in_check() else ""))
        self.draw()

    def start_ai(self):
        self.status.set("Computer is thinking...")
        self.thinking = True
        self.token += 1
        token, snapshot, level = self.token, self.pos.copy(), self.level_var.get()

        def work():
            self.results.put((token, best_move(snapshot, level)))

        threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True).start()
        self.root.after(100, self.poll)

    def poll(self):
        if not self.thinking:
            return
        try:
            token, move = self.results.get_nowait()
        except queue.Empty:
            self.root.after(100, self.poll)
            return
        if token == self.token:
            self.thinking = False
            self.play(move)
        else:
            self.root.after(100, self.poll)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sudoku: puzzle generator, logical hints, notes, undo.

Pure standard library (tkinter), single file, no assets: starts quickly and
idles at a few tens of MB.  Run:  python3 sudoku.py
"""
import random
import time
import tkinter as tk

ALL = 0x3FE  # bits 1..9
ROWS = [[r * 9 + c for c in range(9)] for r in range(9)]
COLS = [[r * 9 + c for r in range(9)] for c in range(9)]
BOXES = [[(br * 3 + r) * 9 + bc * 3 + c for r in range(3) for c in range(3)]
         for br in range(3) for bc in range(3)]
UNITS = ROWS + COLS + BOXES
PEERS = [sorted({j for u in UNITS if i in u for j in u} - {i}) for i in range(81)]
LEVELS = {"Easy": 40, "Medium": 32, "Hard": 26}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- engine
def candidates(v, i):
    used = 0
    for j in PEERS[i]:
        used |= 1 << v[j]
    return ALL & ~used


def solve(v, limit=2, shuffle=False):
    """Return up to `limit` solutions of grid v (list of 81 ints, 0 = empty)."""
    v = v[:]
    sols = []

    def search():
        best, bm, bn = -1, 0, 10
        for i in range(81):
            if v[i] == 0:
                m = candidates(v, i)
                n = bin(m).count("1")
                if n < bn:
                    best, bm, bn = i, m, n
                    if n <= 1:
                        break
        if best < 0:
            sols.append(v[:])
            return
        if bn == 0:
            return
        digits = [d for d in range(1, 10) if bm >> d & 1]
        if shuffle:
            random.shuffle(digits)
        for d in digits:
            v[best] = d
            search()
            if len(sols) >= limit:
                break
        v[best] = 0

    search()
    return sols


def generate(clues):
    """Return (puzzle, solution) with a unique solution and ~`clues` givens."""
    solution = solve([0] * 81, 1, shuffle=True)[0]
    puzzle = solution[:]
    cells = list(range(41))
    random.shuffle(cells)
    left = 81
    for i in cells:
        if left <= clues:
            break
        pair = {i, 80 - i}  # symmetric removal
        saved = {j: puzzle[j] for j in pair}
        for j in pair:
            puzzle[j] = 0
        if len(solve(puzzle, 2)) != 1:
            puzzle.__setitem__(slice(None), puzzle)
            for j, d in saved.items():
                puzzle[j] = d
        else:
            left -= len(pair)
    return puzzle, solution


def find_hint(v, given, solution):
    """Return (cell, digit, explanation, kind). Prefers simple logic."""
    for i in range(81):
        if v[i] and not given[i] and v[i] != solution[i]:
            return i, 0, f"{name(i)} is wrong - it conflicts with the solution.", "wrong"
    cand = {i: candidates(v, i) for i in range(81) if v[i] == 0}
    for i, m in cand.items():
        if bin(m).count("1") == 1:
            d = m.bit_length() - 1
            return (i, d, f"{name(i)} can only be {d}: every other digit is "
                    "already in its row, column or box.", "single")
    labels = ["Row %d" % (k + 1) for k in range(9)] + \
             ["Column %d" % (k + 1) for k in range(9)] + \
             ["Box %d" % (k + 1) for k in range(9)]
    for u, unit in enumerate(UNITS):
        for d in range(1, 10):
            if any(v[i] == d for i in unit):
                continue
            spots = [i for i in unit if i in cand and cand[i] >> d & 1]
            if len(spots) == 1:
                return (spots[0], d, f"{labels[u]}: {d} has only one place "
                        f"left, {name(spots[0])}.", "hidden")
    if not cand:
        return None
    i = min(cand, key=lambda k: bin(cand[k]).count("1"))
    d = solution[i]
    return i, d, f"No simple step found; {name(i)} is {d}.", "reveal"


def name(i):
    return f"R{i // 9 + 1}C{i % 9 + 1}"

BG, PEER, SAME, SEL = "#ffffff", "#eef2f7", "#d6e4f5", "#a9c8ee"
HINT, BAD = "#cdeccb", "#f6c9c9"

        self.root = root
        root.title("Sudoku")
        root.resizable(False, False)
        self.level = tk.StringVar(value="Medium")
        self.notes_mode = False
        self.sel = 40

        self.undo = []

        tk.Button(top, text="New", command=self.new_game).pack(side="left")
        tk.OptionMenu(top, self.level, *LEVELS).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.timer = tk.Label(top, text="0:00", font=("Helvetica", 14))
        self.timer.pack(side="right")

        self.cv = tk.Canvas(root, width=SIZE, height=SIZE, highlightthickness=0)
        self.cv.pack()
        self.cv.bind("<Button-1>", self.click)

        self.status = tk.Label(root, text="", wraplength=SIZE, height=2)
        self.status.pack()

        bar = tk.Frame(root)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Typing Tutor: a desktop app that measures typing speed (WPM) and accuracy.

Run with:  python3 typing_tutor.py
Requires only the Python standard library (tkinter).
"""
import json
import random
import time
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path

PASSAGES = [
    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the sun sets slowly behind the hills.",
    "Practice makes progress. Type each word with care, keep your eyes on the text, and let your fingers find the rhythm.",
    "A good programmer looks both ways before crossing a one-way street, and always writes a test before shipping.",
    "Rain tapped softly on the window as she opened the old book and began to read the first page aloud.",
    "Speed comes from accuracy. Slow down, hit the right keys, and the words per minute will rise on their own.",
    "Coffee, quiet, and a clear desk are all you need to turn a blank page into a finished idea.",
]

STATS_FILE = Path.home() / ".typing_tutor_stats.json"

BG, FG = "#1e1f26", "#d8dae5"
GOOD, BAD, CURSOR_BG = "#7fd687", "#ff6b6b", "#3b3f55"


def compute_stats(correct_keys, total_keys, elapsed):
    """Return (wpm, accuracy%). A 'word' is 5 characters, the standard convention."""
    minutes = elapsed / 60 if elapsed > 0 else 0
    wpm = (correct_keys / 5) / minutes if minutes else 0.0
    accuracy = 100.0 * correct_keys / total_keys if total_keys else 100.0
    return wpm, accuracy


def load_best():
    try:
        return json.loads(STATS_FILE.read_text())
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {"best_wpm": 0.0, "runs": 0}


def save_best(data):
    try:
        STATS_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(data))
    except OSError:
        pass


class TypingTutor(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Typing Tutor")
        self.configure(bg=BG)
        self.geometry("820x460")
        self.minsize(640, 380)
        self.best = load_best()
        self._build_ui()
        self.bind("<Key>", self.on_key)
        self.bind("<Escape>", lambda e: self.new_round())
        self.new_round()

    def _build_ui(self):
        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=24, pady=(20, 8))
        self.wpm_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.acc_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.time_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.best_var = tk.StringVar()
        for var in (self.wpm_var, self.acc_var, self.time_var, self.best_var):
            tk.Label(top, textvariable=var, bg=BG, fg=FG,
                     font=("Helvetica", 15, "bold")).pack(side="left", expand=True)

        self.text = tk.Text(self, wrap="word", bg=BG, fg="#7c8095", relief="flat",
                            font=("Menlo", 20), height=8, padx=24, pady=16,
                            cursor="arrow", highlightthickness=0, spacing2=6)
        self.text.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=12)
        self.text.tag_configure("good", foreground=GOOD)
        self.text.tag_configure("bad", foreground=BAD, underline=True)
        self.text.tag_configure("cursor", background=CURSOR_BG)
        # Keep keystrokes going to the window handler, not the Text widget.
        self.text.bind("<Key>", lambda e: "break")
        self.text.bind("<Button-1>", lambda e: "break")

        self.hint = tk.Label(self, bg=BG, fg="#7c8095", font=("Helvetica", 12))
        self.hint.pack(pady=(0, 6))
        tk.Button(self, text="New passage (Esc)", command=self.new_round,
                  takefocus=0).pack(pady=(0, 16))

    # ---- round lifecycle ----
    def new_round(self):
        self.target = random.choice(PASSAGES)
        self.typed = []
        self.total_keys = 0
        self.correct_keys = 0   # keystrokes that matched at the time they were typed
        self.start = None
        self.finished = False
        self.text.configure(state="normal")
        self.text.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.text.insert("1.0", self.target)
        self.text.configure(state="disabled")
        self.hint.config(text="Start typing to begin. Backspace fixes mistakes.")
        self.refresh_render()
        self.refresh_stats()

"""Typing Tutor: measures typing speed (WPM) and accuracy.

Uses only the Python standard library (tkinter), so it runs unchanged on
Windows, macOS and Linux.
"""
import json
import random
import time
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import font as tkfont
from tkinter import ttk

HISTORY_FILE = Path.home() / ".typing_tutor_history.json"
MAX_HISTORY = 200

PASSAGES = [
    "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the sun sets slowly behind the distant hills.",
    "Programming is the art of telling another human what one wants the computer to do.",
    "A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step, and every expert was once a beginner.",
    "Practice makes progress. Keep your eyes on the text, relax your hands, and let rhythm build speed.",
    "Clear code is written for people first and machines second, so choose names that explain intent.",
    "Rain tapped softly on the window as she opened the old book and began to read the first page.",
    "Accuracy matters more than speed at first; speed will follow once your fingers know where to go.",
    "Technology is best when it brings people together, turning small ideas into things that last.",
]


def load_history():
    try:
        data = json.loads(HISTORY_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return data if isinstance(data, list) else []
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return []


def save_history(history):
    try:
        HISTORY_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(history[-MAX_HISTORY:]), encoding="utf-8")
    except OSError:
        pass


class TypingTutor(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Typing Tutor")
        self.minsize(760, 460)

        self._build_ui()

    # ---- UI ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        pad = {"padx": 16, "pady": 8}
        stats = ttk.Frame(self)
        stats.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        self.vars = {k: tk.StringVar(value=v) for k, v in
                     {"wpm": "0", "acc": "100%", "time": "0.0s"}.items()}
        big = tkfont.Font(size=22, weight="bold")
        for col, (key, label) in enumerate(
                [("wpm", "WPM"), ("acc", "Accuracy"), ("time", "Time")]):
            cell = ttk.Frame(stats)
            cell.grid(row=0, column=col, padx=24)
            ttk.Label(cell, textvariable=self.vars[key], font=big).pack()
            ttk.Label(cell, text=label).pack()
        stats.columnconfigure((0, 1, 2), weight=1)

        mono = tkfont.Font(family="Courier", size=18)
        self.text = tk.Text(self, wrap="word", font=mono, height=7, padx=14,
                            pady=14, relief="flat", cursor="arrow",
                            highlightthickness=1, spacing1=4, spacing3=4)
        self.text.pack(fill="both", expand=True, **pad)
        self.text.tag_configure("correct", foreground="#1a8f3c")
        self.text.tag_configure("wrong", foreground="#ffffff", background="#d33")
        self.text.tag_configure("cursor", background="#ffd54a", foreground="#000")
        self.text.bind("<Key>", self.on_key)
        self.text.bind("<Button-1>", lambda e: (self.text.focus_set(), "break")[1])

        self.message = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Label(self, textvariable=self.message).pack(**pad)

        bottom = ttk.Frame(self)
        bottom.pack(fill="x", **pad)
        ttk.Button(bottom, text="New passage (Esc)", command=self.new_round).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(bottom, text="Restart same text", command=lambda: self.new_round(True)).pack(side="left", padx=8)
        self.best_var = tk.StringVar()
        ttk.Label(bottom, textvariable=self.best_var).pack(side="right")

    # ---- Round logic -------------------------------------------------
    def new_round(self, same=False):
        if not same or not hasattr(self, "target"):
            choices = [p for p in PASSAGES if p != getattr(self, "target", None)]
            self.target = random.choice(choices)
        self.typed = []
        self.keystrokes = 0
        self.errors = 0
        self.start = None
        self.finished = False
        self.text.configure(state="normal")
        self.text.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.text.insert("1.0", self.target)
        self.text.configure(state="disabled")
        self.text.focus_set()
        self.vars["wpm"].set("0")
        self.vars["acc"].set("100%")
        self.vars["time"].set("0.0s")
        self.message.set("Start typing to begin. Backspace corrects mistakes.")
        self._render()
        self._update_best()

    def on_key(self, event):
        if self.finished:
            return "break"
        if event.keysym == "BackSpace":
            if self.typed:
                self.typed.pop()
                self._render()
        elif len(event.char) == 1 and event.char.isprintable() and not (event.state & 0x4):
            if len(self.typed) >= len(self.target):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Typing tutor: measures speed (WPM) and accuracy.

Standard library only (tkinter), so it starts fast and stays small.
Run:  python3 typingtutor.py
Keys: just type. Backspace corrects. Tab or Esc starts a new passage.
"""
import random
import time
import tkinter as tk

WORDS = (
    "the be to of and a in that have it for not on with he as you do at this "
    "but his by from they we say her she or an will my one all would there "
    "their what so up out if about who get which go me when make can like "
    "time no just him know take people into year your good some could them "
    "see other than then now look only come its over think also back after "
    "use two how our work first well way even new want because any these "
    "give day most us keyboard practice speed accuracy rhythm finger screen"
).split()

WORD_COUNT = 25
BG, FG = "#1e1f24", "#6b6f7a"
OK, BAD, CUR = "#e6e6e6", "#ff6b6b", "#3a4a7a"


class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("Typing Tutor")
        root.configure(bg=BG)
        root.geometry("760x340")
        root.minsize(520, 260)

        self.stats = tk.Label(root, text="", font=("Helvetica", 16),
                              bg=BG, fg="#9aa4c7")
        self.stats.pack(pady=(18, 8))

        self.text = tk.Text(root, wrap="word", font=("Menlo", 20), bg=BG,
                            fg=FG, relief="flat", height=6, padx=24, pady=8,
                            cursor="arrow", highlightthickness=0,
                            takefocus=0, spacing1=4)
        self.text.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.text.tag_configure("ok", foreground=OK)
        self.text.tag_configure("bad", foreground=BAD, underline=True)
        self.text.tag_configure("cur", background=CUR)

        self.hint = tk.Label(root, text="Start typing. Tab/Esc = new passage",
                             font=("Helvetica", 11), bg=BG, fg=FG)
        self.hint.pack(pady=(0, 10))

        root.bind("<Key>", self.on_key)
        self.new_round()
        self.tick()

    # --- state -----------------------------------------------------------
    def new_round(self):
        self.target = " ".join(random.choices(WORDS, k=WORD_COUNT))
        self.typed = []          # chars currently typed (backspace removes)
        self.keystrokes = 0      # every printable key pressed
        self.errors = 0          # keystrokes that did not match, even if fixed
        self.start = None
        self.end = None
        self.text.configure(state="normal")
        self.text.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.text.insert("1.0", self.target)
        self.text.tag_remove("ok", "1.0", "end")
        self.text.tag_remove("bad", "1.0", "end")
        self.text.configure(state="disabled")
        self.mark_cursor()
        self.hint.configure(text="Start typing. Tab/Esc = new passage")
        self.update_stats()

    def mark_cursor(self):
        self.text.tag_remove("cur", "1.0", "end")
        i = len(self.typed)
        if i < len(self.target):
            self.text.tag_add("cur", f"1.0+{i}c", f"1.0+{i + 1}c")
            self.text.see(f"1.0+{i}c")

    # --- input -----------------------------------------------------------
    def on_key(self, e):
        if e.keysym in ("Tab", "Escape"):
            self.new_round()
            return "break"
        if self.end is not None:
            return
        if e.keysym == "BackSpace":
            if self.typed:
                self.typed.pop()
                i = len(self.typed)
                self.text.tag_remove("ok", f"1.0+{i}c", f"1.0+{i + 1}c")
                self.text.tag_remove("bad", f"1.0+{i}c", f"1.0+{i + 1}c")
                self.mark_cursor()
            return
        ch = e.char
        if len(ch) != 1 or ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127:
            return
        if self.start is None:
            self.start = time.perf_counter()
        i = len(self.typed)
        good = ch == self.target[i]
        self.typed.append(ch)
        self.keystrokes += 1
        if not good:
            self.errors += 1
        self.text.tag_add("ok" if good else "bad",
                          f"1.0+{i}c", f"1.0+{i + 1}c")
        self.mark_cursor()
        if len(self.typed) == len(self.target):
            self.end = time.perf_counter()
            self.update_stats()
            self.hint.configure(text="Done! Tab/Esc = new passage")
        else:
            self.update_stats()

    # --- metrics ---------------------------------------------------------
    def correct_chars(self):
        return sum(a == b for a, b in zip(self.typed, self.target))

    def update_stats(self):
        if self.start is None:
            wpm, elapsed = 0, 0.0
        else:
            elapsed = (self.end or time.perf_counter()) - self.start
            # standard: 5 characters = 1 word; only currently-correct chars count
            wpm = (self.correct_chars() / 5) / (elapsed / 60) if elapsed > 0.5 else 0
        acc = 100.0 if not self.keystrokes else \
            100.0 * (self.keystrokes - self.errors) / self.keystrokes
        self.stats.configure(
            text=f"{wpm:5.0f} WPM     {acc:5.1f}% accuracy     {elapsed:4.1f}s")

    def tick(self):
        # redraw only while a round is running; idle otherwise (no CPU use)
        if self.start is not None and self.end is None:
            self.update_stats()
        self.root.after(250, self.tick)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    App(root)
    root.mainloop()

MAX_BOX = 5


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path=DATA_FILE):
        self.path = path
        self.words = []
        self.next_id = 1
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        if self.path.exists():
            try:
                data = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                self.words = data.get("words", [])
                self.next_id = data.get("next_id", len(self.words) + 1)
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError):
                messagebox.showwarning("Vocab Trainer", "Could not read saved data; starting empty.")

    def save(self):
        payload = {"words": self.words, "next_id": self.next_id}
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    def add(self, term, translation, example=""):
        word = {"id": self.next_id, "term": term, "translation": translation,
                "example": example, "box": 1, "correct": 0, "wrong": 0, "last": 0}
        self.next_id += 1
        self.words.append(word)
        self.save()
        return word

    def update(self, wid, term, translation, example):
        for w in self.words:
            if w["id"] == wid:
                w.update(term=term, translation=translation, example=example)
        self.save()

    def delete(self, wid):
        self.words = [w for w in self.words if w["id"] != wid]
        self.save()

    def record(self, word, ok):
        if ok:
            word["correct"] += 1
            word["box"] = min(MAX_BOX, word["box"] + 1)
        else:
            word["wrong"] += 1
            word["box"] = 1
        word["last"] = time.time()
        self.save()

        self.question = ttk.Label(self, text="Press “Start quiz”", font=("TkDefaultFont", 22),
                                  anchor="center", wraplength=500)
        self.question.pack(fill="x", pady=24)

        self.body = ttk.Frame(self)
        self.body.pack(fill="x")
        self.feedback = ttk.Label(self, text="", anchor="center", font=("TkDefaultFont", 13))
        self.feedback.pack(fill="x", pady=12)
        self.next_btn = ttk.Button(self, text="Next", command=self.next_question)

    # --- session flow ---
    def start(self):
        if len(self.store.words) < 2:
            messagebox.showinfo("Quiz", "Add at least two words first.")
            return
        self.queue = core.pick_session(self.store.words, SESSION_LEN)
        self.score = self.total = 0
        self.next_question()

    def next_question(self):
        self.next_btn.pack_forget()
        self.feedback.config(text="")
        for child in self.body.winfo_children():
            child.destroy()
        if not self.queue:
            self.current = None
            self.question.config(text=f"Done! Score: {self.score}/{self.total}")
            self.progress.config(text="")
            return
        self.current, self.answered = self.queue.pop(), False
        self.reverse = self.direction.get().startswith("Translation")
        qf, self.af = core.fields(self.reverse)
        self.question.config(text=self.current[qf])
        self.progress.config(text=f"{self.total + 1}/{self.total + 1 + len(self.queue)}")
        if self.mode.get() == "Typing":
            self.entry = ttk.Entry(self.body, font=("TkDefaultFont", 14), justify="center")
            self.entry.pack(fill="x", padx=60)
            self.entry.focus_set()
            self.entry.bind("<Return>", self._on_enter)
        else:
            opts = core.choices(self.store.words, self.current, self.af)
            for i, opt in enumerate(opts, 1):
                b = ttk.Button(self.body, text=f"{i}. {opt}",
                               command=lambda o=opt: self.submit(o))
                b.pack(fill="x", padx=60, pady=2)
            for i in range(len(opts)):
                self.winfo_toplevel().bind(
                    str(i + 1), lambda e, o=opts[i]: self.submit(o) if not self.answered else None)

    def _on_enter(self, _):
        if self.answered:
            self.next_question()
        else:
            self.submit(self.entry.get())

    def submit(self, guess):
        if self.answered or not self.current:
            return
        self.answered = True
        answer = self.current[self.af]
        if self.mode.get() == "Typing":
            result = core.check_typed(guess, answer)
        else:
            result = "exact" if guess == answer else None
        ok = result is not None
        core.grade(self.current, ok)
        self.total += 1
        self.score += ok
        if result == "exact":
            self.feedback.config(text="✓ Correct", foreground="#2e7d32")
        elif result == "accent":
            self.feedback.config(text=f"✓ Correct (mind the accents: {answer})", foreground="#2e7d32")
        else:
            self.feedback.config(text=f"✗ Answer: {answer}", foreground="#c62828")
        self.store.save()
        self.on_change()
        self.next_btn.pack()
        self.next_btn.focus_set()
        self.next_btn.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.next_question())


class WordsTab(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, store, on_change):
        super().__init__(master, padding=12)
        self.store, self.on_change = store, on_change

        for col, text, w in (("term", "Word", 180), ("tr", "Translation", 220), ("box", "Level", 60)):
            self.tree.heading(col, text=text)
            self.tree.column(col, width=w)
        self.tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=8)
        self.tree.bind("<Delete>", lambda e: self.delete())

        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Delete selected", command=self.delete).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(bar, text="Import CSV…", command=self.import_csv).pack(side="left", padx=6)

APP_NAME = "VocabTrainer"
MAX_BOX = 5


def data_dir():
    if sys.platform.startswith("win"):

    elif sys.platform == "darwin":
        base = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support")
    else:
        base = os.environ.get("XDG_DATA_HOME") or os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share")
    path = os.path.join(base, APP_NAME)
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    return path


class Store:
    """JSON persistence. decks: {name: [{term, translation, box, correct, wrong}]}"""

    def __init__(self):
        self.path = os.path.join(data_dir(), "decks.json")
        self.decks = {}
        self.load()

    def load(self):
        try:
            with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.decks = json.load(f).get("decks", {})
        except FileNotFoundError:
            self.decks = {
                "Spanish basics": [
                    self.new_word(t, tr)
                    for t, tr in [
                        ("hola", "hello"), ("adiós", "goodbye"), ("gracias", "thank you"),
                        ("por favor", "please"), ("agua", "water"), ("casa", "house"),
                        ("gato", "cat"), ("perro", "dog"),
                    ]
                ]
            }
            self.save()
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
            messagebox.showerror(APP_NAME, f"Could not read {self.path}:\n{e}\n\nStarting empty.")
            self.decks = {}

    def save(self):
        tmp = self.path + ".tmp"
        with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"decks": self.decks}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        os.replace(tmp, self.path)

    @staticmethod
    def new_word(term, translation):
        return {"term": term, "translation": translation, "box": 1, "correct": 0, "wrong": 0}


def answers_of(text):
    """Accepted answers: alternatives separated by ';' or '/'."""
    parts = text.replace("/", ";").split(";")
    return [p.strip().casefold() for p in parts if p.strip()]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Vocabulary trainer: spaced-repetition quizzes. Python stdlib + Tkinter only."""
import csv
import json
import os
import random
import re
import time
import tkinter as tk
import unicodedata
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

DATA_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".vocab_trainer.json")
DAY = 86400
# Seconds until a word is due again, indexed by Leitner box (0 = new/missed).
INTERVALS = [0, 10 * 60, DAY, 3 * DAY, 7 * DAY, 21 * DAY]
MAX_BOX = len(INTERVALS) - 1

SAMPLE = [
    ("hola", "hello"), ("adiós", "goodbye"), ("gracias", "thank you"),
    ("por favor", "please"), ("agua", "water"), ("pan", "bread"),
    ("casa", "house"), ("perro", "dog"), ("gato", "cat"), ("libro", "book"),
    ("amigo", "friend"), ("comer", "to eat"), ("beber", "to drink"),
    ("rojo", "red"), ("azul", "blue"),
]


def new_word(term, meaning):
    return {"term": term, "meaning": meaning, "box": 0, "due": 0}


def strip_accents(s):
    return "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
                   if unicodedata.category(c) != "Mn")


def norm(s):
    return " ".join(strip_accents(s).casefold().split())


class Store:
    def __init__(self, path=DATA_FILE):
        self.path = path
        try:
            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                self.words = json.load(f)["words"]
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
            self.words = [new_word(t, m) for t, m in SAMPLE]
            self.save()

    def save(self):
        tmp = self.path + ".tmp"
        with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({"words": self.words}, f, ensure_ascii=False)
        os.replace(tmp, self.path)

    def has(self, term):
        return any(w["term"].casefold() == term.casefold() for w in self.words)

    def add(self, term, meaning):
        if term and meaning and not self.has(term):
            self.words.append(new_word(term, meaning))
            return True
        return False

    def due_count(self):
        now = time.time()
        return sum(1 for w in self.words if w["due"] <= now)

    def pick(self, exclude=None):
        pool = [w for w in self.words if w is not exclude] or self.words
        now = time.time()
        due = [w for w in pool if w["due"] <= now]
        if due:
            due.sort(key=lambda w: (w["box"], w["due"]))
            return random.choice(due[:5])
        return min(pool, key=lambda w: w["due"])  # nothing due: soonest first

    def grade(self, w, ok):
        w["box"] = min(w["box"] + 1, MAX_BOX) if ok else 0
        w["due"] = time.time() + INTERVALS[w["box"]]
        self.save()


class Quiz(ttk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, master, store):
        super().__init__(master, padding=16)
        self.store = store
        self.word = None
        self.answered = False
        self.right = self.total = 0
        self.buttons = []
        self.entry = None

        self.direction = tk.StringVar(value="Term → Meaning")
        self.mode = tk.StringVar(value="Multiple choice")

        bar = ttk.Frame(self)
        bar.pack(fill="x")
        for var, values in ((self.direction, ("Term → Meaning", "Meaning → Term")),
                            (self.mode, ("Multiple choice", "Typing"))):
            cb = ttk.Combobox(bar, textvariable=var, values=values,
                              state="readonly", width=16)
            cb.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 8))
            cb.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.next())
        self.status = ttk.Label(bar)
        self.status.pack(side="right")

        self.prompt = ttk.Label(self, font=("Helvetica", 30), anchor="center",
                                wraplength=520, justify="center")
        self.prompt.pack(fill="x", pady=(28, 18))
        self.area = ttk.Frame(self)
        self.area.pack()
        self.feedback = ttk.Label(self, font=("Helvetica", 14), anchor="center")
        self.feedback.pack(fill="x", pady=12)
        self.next_btn = ttk.Button(self, text="Next (Enter)", command=self.next)
        self.next_btn.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.next())

        self.bind_all("<Key>", self.on_key)

    # -- helpers
    def qa(self, w):
        if self.direction.get().startswith("Term"):
            return w["term"], w["meaning"]
        return w["meaning"], w["term"]

    def update_status(self):
        self.status.config(
            text=f"Due {self.store.due_count()}/{len(self.store.words)}   "
                 f"Score {self.right}/{self.total}")

    def clear(self):
        for child in self.area.winfo_children():
            child.destroy()
        self.buttons = []
        self.entry = None
        self.feedback.config(text="")
        self.next_btn.pack_forget()

    # -- flow
    def next(self):
        self.clear()
        self.answered = False
        self.update_status()
        if len(self.store.words) < 2:
            self.word = None
            self.prompt.config(text="Add at least 2 words in the Words tab.")
            return
        self.word = self.store.pick(self.word)
        q, a = self.qa(self.word)
        self.prompt.config(text=q)
        if self.mode.get() == "Typing":
            self.entry = ttk.Entry(self.area, font=("Helvetica", 18), width=28)
            self.entry.pack(pady=4)
            self.entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.submit_text())
            self.entry.focus_set()
            ttk.Button(self.area, text="Check", command=self.submit_text).pack(pady=6)
        else:
            others = list({self.qa(w)[1] for w in self.store.words
                           if w is not self.word and norm(self.qa(w)[1]) != norm(a)})
            options = random.sample(others, min(3, len(others))) + [a]
            random.shuffle(options)
            for i, opt in enumerate(options, 1):
                b = ttk.Button(self.area, text=f"{i}.  {opt}", width=36,
                               command=lambda o=opt: self.submit_choice(o))
                b.pack(pady=3, ipady=4)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Home book library catalogue. Single file, standard library only.

Fast start / low memory by design: SQLite storage, a list that loads only
the columns it shows, and one cover image in memory at a time (covers are
downsized to small PNG thumbnails on import).
"""
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import uuid
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

APP = "BookLibrary"
if os.environ.get("BOOKLIB_HOME"):
    HOME = os.environ["BOOKLIB_HOME"]
elif sys.platform == "darwin":
    HOME = os.path.expanduser(f"~/Library/Application Support/{APP}")
else:
    HOME = os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/booklibrary")
COVERS = os.path.join(HOME, "covers")
os.makedirs(COVERS, exist_ok=True)

COVER_MAX = 450  # longest side of stored thumbnail, px
FIELDS = [("title", "Title"), ("author", "Author"), ("year", "Year"),
          ("isbn", "ISBN"), ("genre", "Genre"), ("location", "Shelf / location")]
STATUSES = ["Unread", "Reading", "Read"]
SORTS = {"title": "title COLLATE NOCASE", "author": "author COLLATE NOCASE",
         "year": "year", "status": "status"}


def open_db():
    db = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(HOME, "library.db"))
    db.execute("""CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT DEFAULT '',
        year TEXT DEFAULT '', isbn TEXT DEFAULT '', genre TEXT DEFAULT '',
        location TEXT DEFAULT '', status TEXT DEFAULT 'Unread',
        notes TEXT DEFAULT '', cover TEXT DEFAULT '')""")
    return db


def make_thumbnail(src):
    """Convert any image to a small PNG in COVERS; return its filename."""
    name = uuid.uuid4().hex + ".png"
    dest = os.path.join(COVERS, name)
    size = str(COVER_MAX)
    if shutil.which("sips"):  # macOS built-in; handles JPEG/HEIC/etc.
        r = subprocess.run(["sips", "-s", "format", "png", "-Z", size, src,
                            "--out", dest], capture_output=True)
        if r.returncode == 0 and os.path.exists(dest):
            return name
    try:
        from PIL import Image
        with Image.open(src) as im:
            im.thumbnail((COVER_MAX, COVER_MAX))
            im.convert("RGB").save(dest, "PNG")
        return name
    except ImportError:
        pass
    if src.lower().endswith((".png", ".gif")):  # Tk reads these natively
        shutil.copyfile(src, dest)
        return name
    raise RuntimeError("Can't convert this image. Use a PNG/GIF or install "
                       "Pillow (pip install pillow).")


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Book Library")
        self.geometry("1000x620")
        self.minsize(800, 500)
        self.db = open_db()
        self.current = None      # id of the book being edited, None = new
        self.cover_name = ""     # cover filename for the current form
        self.photo = None        # the single cached PhotoImage
        self.order = "title"
        self.after_id = None
        self.vars = {k: tk.StringVar() for k, _ in FIELDS}
        self.status = tk.StringVar(value=STATUSES[0])
        self.query = tk.StringVar()
        self.count = tk.StringVar()
        self.build()
        self.query.trace_add("write", self.debounce)
        self.refresh()
        self.new_book()

    # ---------- UI ----------
    def build(self):
        left = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        left.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        top = ttk.Frame(left)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="Search").pack(side="left")
        e = ttk.Entry(top, textvariable=self.query)
        e.pack(side="left", fill="x", expand=True, padx=6)
        e.focus_set()

        cols = ("title", "author", "year", "status")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(left, columns=cols, show="headings",
                                 selectmode="browse")
        for c, w in zip(cols, (240, 160, 55, 70)):
            self.tree.heading(c, text=c.title(),
                              command=lambda c=c: self.sort_by(c))
            self.tree.column(c, width=w, stretch=c in ("title", "author"))
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(left, command=self.tree.yview)

        self.cover.pack()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Workout log: exercises, sets and progress charts.

Pure standard library (tkinter + sqlite3), so there is nothing to install,
startup is near-instant and memory use stays small.
Data lives in ~/.workout_log/log.db
"""
import os
import sqlite3
import tkinter as tk
from datetime import date
from tkinter import messagebox, ttk

DB_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".workout_log")

METRICS = {
    "Best weight": "MAX(weight)",
    "Estimated 1RM (Epley)": "MAX(weight * (1 + reps / 30.0))",
    "Volume (weight x reps)": "SUM(weight * reps)",
}


def open_db():
    os.makedirs(DB_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    db = sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(DB_DIR, "log.db"))
    db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    db.executescript(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exercises (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sets (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            day TEXT NOT NULL,
            weight REAL NOT NULL,
            reps INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sets_ex_day ON sets(exercise_id, day);
        """
    )
    return db


def fmt(x):
    return f"{x:.1f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


class App(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Workout Log")
        self.geometry("900x560")
        self.minsize(700, 420)
        self.db = open_db()
        self.ex_ids = []  # listbox index -> exercise id

        self.build_ui()
        self.refresh_exercises()

    # ---------- UI ----------
    def build_ui(self):
        left = ttk.Frame(self, padding=8)
        left.pack(side="left", fill="y")
        ttk.Label(left, text="Exercises").pack(anchor="w")
        self.ex_list = tk.Listbox(left, width=24, exportselection=False)
        self.ex_list.pack(fill="y", expand=True, pady=4)
        self.ex_list.bind("<<ListboxSelect>>", lambda e: self.on_select())

        entry.bind("<Return>", lambda e: self.add_exercise())
        row = ttk.Frame(left)
        row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        ttk.Button(row, text="Add", command=self.add_exercise).pack(side="left", expand=True, fill="x")
        ttk.Button(row, text="Delete", command=self.delete_exercise).pack(side="left", expand=True, fill="x")

        self.tabs.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(0, 8), pady=8)
        self.log_tab = ttk.Frame(self.tabs, padding=8)
        self.chart_tab = ttk.Frame(self.tabs, padding=8)
        self.tabs.add(self.log_tab, text="Log")
        self.tabs.add(self.chart_tab, text="Progress")
        self.tabs.bind("<<NotebookTabChanged>>", lambda e: self.draw_chart())

        self.build_log_tab()
        self.build_chart_tab()

    def build_log_tab(self):
        f = ttk.Frame(self.log_tab)
        f.pack(fill="x")
        self.day_var = tk.StringVar(value=date.today().isoformat())
        self.weight_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.reps_var = tk.StringVar()
        for text, var, w in (("Date", self.day_var, 11), ("Weight", self.weight_var, 8), ("Reps", self.reps_var, 6)):
            ttk.Label(f, text=text).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 4))
            e = ttk.Entry(f, textvariable=var, width=w)
            e.pack(side="left", padx=(0, 10))
            e.bind("<Return>", lambda ev: self.add_set())
        ttk.Button(f, text="Add set", command=self.add_set).pack(side="left")
        ttk.Button(f, text="Delete selected", command=self.delete_sets).pack(side="right")

        cols = ("day", "set", "weight", "reps")
        self.tree = ttk.Treeview(self.log_tab, columns=cols, show="headings", selectmode="extended")
        for c, t, w in (("day", "Date", 110), ("set", "Set", 50), ("weight", "Weight", 90), ("reps", "Reps", 70)):
            self.tree.heading(c, text=t)
            self.tree.column(c, width=w, anchor="center")
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(self.log_tab, orient="vertical", command=self.tree.yview)
        self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        self.tree.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, pady=(8, 0))
        sb.pack(side="left", fill="y", pady=(8, 0))

    def build_chart_tab(self):
        top = ttk.Frame(self.chart_tab)
        top.pack(fill="x")
        ttk.Label(top, text="Metric").pack(side="left", padx=(0, 4))
        self.metric = tk.StringVar(value=next(iter(METRICS)))
        cb = ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.metric, values=list(METRICS), state="readonly", width=26)
        cb.pack(side="left")
        cb.bind("<<ComboboxSelected>>", lambda e: self.draw_chart())
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.chart_tab, bg="white", highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.pack(fill="both", expand=True, pady=(8, 0))
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", lambda e: self.draw_chart())

    # ---------- exercises ----------
    def refresh_exercises(self, select_id=None):
        rows = self.db.execute("SELECT id, name FROM exercises ORDER BY name").fetchall()
        self.ex_ids = [r[0] for r in rows]
        self.ex_list.delete(0, "end")
        for _, name in rows:
            self.ex_list.insert("end", name)
        if self.ex_ids:
            idx = self.ex_ids.index(select_id) if select_id in self.ex_ids else 0
            self.ex_list.selection_set(idx)
        self.on_select()

    def current_ex(self):
        sel = self.ex_list.curselection()
        return self.ex_ids[sel[0]] if sel else None
